discussions.title: RFC: official plugin scaffold — template repo + pnpm create dsh-plugin to unblock the ecosystem

nodes.body:
Thanks for the detailed field report from deepseek-heartflow — "格式对但结构不对" is exactly the failure mode I was worried about, and the version-train silent-failure story (like #1633) makes the case for pinning even stronger.

I went ahead and prototyped the scaffold as a real, verified community template so the RFC has something concrete to react to:

**https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-template**

It includes the two files you suggested: a minimal runnable example (one `hello` tool with schema, render, presentCall, and cancellation) and a CI workflow that does build → test → `pnpm pack` → `dsh plugin --profile web add` → `--dump-config` → boot `dsh web` + HTTP check. So "loads in dsh" is proven by CI, not assumed.

On your `dsh plugin check` idea: I agree it is the scalable answer — a local check (manifest structure, bundle loadability, peer version match) beats maintainer review for 1700+ plugins. Until an official command exists, the template's CI performs exactly those three checks, and the README's publishing checklist mirrors them so authors can self-verify locally:

1. `pnpm build` + `pnpm test` pass
2. `dsh plugin add` + `dsh web` boot succeed
3. peers pinned to the current train (`0.1.0-rc.6`)

Happy to fold any of this into an official template if the team picks up the RFC. Also fine to keep iterating on the community version — PRs/issues welcome.

---

谢谢 deepseek-heartflow 的实战反馈！我把 RFC 里的脚手架先做成了一个可运行的社区模板（链接见上），包含最小示例 + CI 冒烟加载。`dsh plugin check` 的建议非常对，官方命令落地前，模板的 CI 已经在做这三项检查（manifest 结构 / bundle 可加载 / 依赖版本对齐）。

Following up on the review thread: both concrete pieces are now shipped.

**1. `dsh plugin check` as a real tool — [dsh-plugin-doctor](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor)**

- Checks manifest structure, patch validity, entry points, files allowlist
- `--build` runs the real build; `--full` packs, installs into a brand-new `DSH_HOME` profile, and verifies the plugin id in `--dump-config`
- `--json` + exit code for CI; verified `--full` PASS against the template

**2. The template CI now proves real tool callability — [dsh-plugin-template](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-template)**

- `scripts/integration-test.mjs` installs the actual packed tarball, registers `hello` through `apply()` / `ctx.tools.register`, executes the real handler, and asserts `Hello, Ada!` (plus a guard-rejection scenario against an incompatible older RC)
- `scripts/dsh-smoke.sh` boots `dsh web` in a fresh profile (Windows runner; the upstream npm CLI currently lacks the linux-x64 `pty.node` prebuild — [discussion #1686](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1686))
- CI is green end to end

**On the version-train concern:** we verified empirically (pnpm 11) that neither caret nor exact ranges make pnpm auto-upgrade an older RC in the host — it silently links the old version with only a generic warning. The template therefore keeps an honest `^0.1.0-rc.6` range **and** refuses to load at runtime when the resolved `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` does not satisfy it, so the silent case becomes a loud, actionable error. Full details in the template README Troubleshooting.

Happy to keep iterating — an official `dsh plugin check` would still be the right long-term home for this logic.

Following this RFC's direction, there is now a formal proposal plus a running reference implementation for the pre-publish surface:

- **RFC #1846**: community plugin registry contract v2 + first-class `dsh plugin check` (exit 0/1/2) + `dsh doctor` (dsh-doctor/v1 JSON envelope)
- **Running implementation**: `dsh-plugin-doctor v1.7.0` now exposes `check <dir>` (alias of the pre-publish pipeline: manifest ? patch ? entry ? build ? pack ? fresh-profile install ? config), exactly matching the proposed command surface: https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor/releases/tag/v1.7.0
- Fixtures + cross-implementation acceptance harness are included (clean/BOM/shadow profiles, envelope assertions)

If the maintainers prefer a different name/shape for the command, this is the cheapest moment to change it ? the implementation is one alias away.

The preflight idea from this RFC is now a turnkey GitHub Action - plugin authors can run the same checks in CI without learning the doctor CLI.

```yaml
- uses: zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor-action@v1
  with: { path: . }
```

This maps directly onto the `dsh plugin check` surface discussed here: manifest structure, patch validity, entry points, files allowlist, and an optional build + pack + fresh-profile install smoke. Repo: https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor-action

官方 plugin scaffold（模板仓库 + pnpm create dsh-plugin）——这个提案切中生态痛点：现在发插件要先搞懂 bundle/挂载，脚手架能大幅降低门槛。

我们手册第 4 章也有可克隆模板（纯函数+waterfall+测试），官方脚手架出来后可以互相补位：https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook/tree/main/examples/plugin-template

这个 scaffold 对**新写原生 DSH 插件**很有价值；另外建议官方/社区模板把“已有生态来源”作为第一步分流：如果能力本来就是 Pi extension，没必要先复制引擎再手写一套 DSH wrapper。

[`pi2dsh`](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 现在的安装面已经收敛成 DSH 官方命令：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add <Pi 插件原包>
```

它在加载时把 Pi 的 tools、commands、events、model/provider、sessions/subagents 等 ABI 投影到 DSH；包还是原包，升级仍跟 Pi 上游走，不需要生成 bundle 或维护一份 fork。真实 DSH loop 已跑通 vision、subagents、web search/fetch、memory、side conversation 等不同形态。

所以我建议 scaffold/doctor 的入口先问一句：

1. 新能力、要用 DSH 原生 client/Host surface → 走本帖官方 scaffold；
2. 已存在的 Pi package、主要是 Agent extension 能力 → 先用 pi2dsh 原包安装；
3. 只有确实碰到未映射的 Host/client seam，才生成一个最小适配层，并把缺口回灌兼容引擎。

这样 scaffold 不只是“更快造新插件”，还可以避免生态里出现大量对既有 Pi 包的逐包复制和后续版本漂移。

discussions.title: [Idea] Long-term memory capability seam (dsh-memory + TencentDB Agent Memory provider + tools)

nodes.body:
This is a good fit for an optional capability seam, and the decision not to put an opaque reverse proxy in the model path is especially sound. I would tighten five contracts before treating the interface as stable.

### 1. Isolation identity must not be model-controlled

The provider call needs an execution-owned scope such as tenant / principal / agent / workspace / session. Those identifiers should come from the host context, not from `memory_save` or `memory_search` arguments. Otherwise a prompt-injected model can ask the tool to search another user or agent namespace.

A useful invariant is:

```
model chooses: query, note, recall intent
host chooses: tenant, principal, agent, workspace, provider route
```

The seam can remain provider-neutral, but the scope needs to be part of its contract from v1. Adding it later will be a breaking change.

### 2. Do not expose tools that can only fail

> no provider simply means the tools register and fail at execution time

That makes the advertised tool surface disagree with the assembled runtime. It costs context and teaches the model to call an unavailable capability. Prefer conditional tool registration when `ctx.memory` has no usable provider, or expose an availability projection that the tool bundle uses during composition. A structured `MemoryError` is still required for runtime loss after registration, but it should not be normal discovery behavior.

### 3. Save needs idempotency and an explicit effect contract

A memory write is an external, durable effect. Agent-loop retry, transport ambiguity, or session resume can execute the same logical save more than once. The provider contract should accept an idempotency key owned by the harness—ideally derived from the durable tool-call/session event identity—not generated by the model.

Also declare whether `save` requires approval and which audit event proves it committed. “Request timed out” is not equivalent to “write did not happen.”

### 4. A timeout wrapper does not cancel the write

Because the SDK has no `AbortSignal`, `Promise.race` can bound the agent’s wait but cannot stop the underlying request. A late `save` may still commit after DSH reports timeout. That produces an unknown outcome, not a clean failure. I would give writes a distinct error such as `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, pair it with the idempotency key, and document reconciliation/retry behavior. Reads can use an ordinary timeout classification.

### 5. Recalled memory is untrusted content with provenance

L1/L3 output can contain stale instructions, prompt injection, or data written by another workflow. Return typed records with source, scope, timestamps, stable IDs, and confidence—not only concatenated text. Keep result-count and byte/token caps in the provider/tool boundary. The system prompt should state that recalled text is evidence/data, never a higher-priority instruction.

A narrow v1 surface is still the right choice. I would keep `save/search/readProfile`, but make scope, provenance, idempotency, effect policy, and unknown-outcome semantics explicit before adding delete/update. Those five decisions determine whether providers remain interchangeable and whether the memory seam is safe to compose into multiple agent products.

I turned this review into a reusable, source-backed checklist that also separates Session replay, compaction, Skills, and cross-session memory: [handbook PR #12](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/pull/12). Corrections against the proposed seam or current DSH Session/MCP behavior are welcome there.

A useful implementation data point for this seam: DSH can already run an existing Pi memory package unchanged through the public plugin path.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-hermes-memory
```

We verified the important persistence boundary on a real DSH runtime: process A wrote with `memory_add`; a fresh process B recovered it with `memory_search`. The package also exposes add/replace/remove/search, global/project stores, session search, and on-demand retrieval. No DSH source fork or LLM reverse proxy is involved: https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh

That does not replace the proposed provider-neutral `ctx.memory` contract, but it gives the RFC a deployable comparison point: explicit memory tools and cross-session persistence work today, while the native seam can focus on the harder host-owned contracts already raised here—scope identity, provenance, idempotency, approval/effect semantics, and unknown outcomes.

discussions.title: Skill loader returns 'unknown or no longer available' for skills that exist on disk (session catalog snapshot)

nodes.body:
这个时间相关性很有价值，但从 rc.6 当前实现看，**“catalog 在 session start 固定快照”并不是既定机制**，需要先把这个假设与复现分开：

- `dsh-tool-skill` 在每个 eligible `agent/pre-step` 调用 `ctx.skills.snapshot({cwd, scope: agent})`；digest 变化会向同一 session 追加完整 replacement catalog。
- `skill` tool 每次执行时都会用当前 Agent scope 现场调用 `ctx.skills.list()`，找到 summary 后再调用 `ctx.skills.get()` 读取当前 body。
- filesystem provider 默认 `watch: true`，catalog frontmatter 的新增/删除/修改会 invalidation；完整 body 则每次 load 重新读取。

所以报错能证明的是“**该次 live scoped lookup 没有解析出这个 name，或它在 list→get 之间消失**”，还不能证明它只信任 session 里的旧 catalog。

这组环境里更值得优先验证：

1. 运行进程实际使用的 `DSH_HOME` 是否始终是 `D:\dsh-home`，而不是 UI/子进程落到另一个 home。
2. junction 批量建立期间，watcher/discovery 是否报告 I/O error 或 incomplete snapshot；不要只看目标 `SKILL.md` 最终存在。
3. frontmatter 在失败时刻是否已经是有效 kebab-case `name` + 非空 `description`；malformed entry 会被跳过并记录 warning。
4. 同名 skill 是否被更高 rank 的 project/custom layer shadow，且 winning candidate 在扫描期间变化。
5. 失败发生在第一次 `list()` miss，还是 summary 已找到但第二次 `get()` miss；目前两处使用同一句错误文案，session log 本身无法区分。

建议的最小判定测试是：先用一个稳定目录启动 session 并完成一次 step，再原子地加入全新 skill，等待 watcher stability window 后，在**同一 session 的下一 step**观察 replacement `<available_skills>`，随后调用它。按设计无需新建 session；如果只有新 session 成功，就是可操作的 hot-refresh 回归证据。

不建议用“miss 后直接读取 `~/.dsh/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`”作为通用修复。那会绕过 cwd/project scope、provider precedence、custom roots、`disable-model-invocation` 和非 filesystem provider，可能把本来不可对模型暴露的 skill 打开。更安全的修复方向是让 live registry lookup 在 incomplete/racing observation 时重试稳定 revision，并把 `incomplete discovery`、`summary vanished before get` 与真正 unknown 分成不同诊断。

对应源码与契约：

- Per-step hot refresh: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/skill/tool-skill/src/index.ts#L216-L247
- Live list→get loader: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/skill/tool-skill/src/index.ts#L122-L149
- Filesystem watcher and current-body contract: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/skill/skill-filesystem/README.md#catalog-change-detection

Handbook 的 Skill discovery / precedence / invocation 图：
https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/agent-patterns/skills.md

这个企业部署场景可以直接换一个 `web_search` 实现，不必让搜索继续绑定官方端点：Pi 生态的 [`@juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools) 可通过 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 原包运行在 DSH。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools
```

```sh
export WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER=searxng
export SEARXNG_URL=https://search.example.internal
dsh web
```

`web_fetch` 自带 private/loopback/metadata 地址拦截；长页面会把全文写入临时文件供模型按需读取，避免一次塞满上下文。

这条链路已经在真实 DSH runtime 执行过搜索和网页全文抓取，不只是“插件能加载”；证据在 [runtime results](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/blob/main/community/runtime-results.json)。对原帖“搜索必须经过企业网关/自托管代理”的需求，现在即可直接使用。

discussions.title: 主Agent与子Agent调用模型不一致问题

nodes.body:
如果目标是先避免“主 Agent 已切换、子 Agent 还偷偷走旧的官方模型”，现在可以用 Pi 的子代理实现绕开这条原生继承缺口：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @tintinweb/pi-subagents
```

这个包注册 `Agent` 工具。默认子代理的 `model` 是 **inherit parent**；通过 pi2dsh 创建时，Pi 的 `createAgentSession` 会被映射成 DSH 真正的 `ctx.agents` child，并把创建当刻父会话的 provider/model 传进 child 的 `agentOptions`，不是在插件里另起一个假的模型循环。

如果希望完全消除隐式继承，也可以给某类子代理显式钉模型：

```md
---
model: my-gateway/glm-5.3
tools: read, grep, find
---

你是只读代码检索子代理。
```

保存到项目的 `.pi/agents/researcher.md` 后，主 Agent 调用：

```text
Agent({ subagent_type: "researcher", prompt: "检查这个问题" })
```

这样“跟随父模型”和“每类子代理固定模型”都可控。我们已验证这不是只挂载了工具名：`@tintinweb/pi-subagents` 通过 pi2dsh 启动的是带独立 durable session 的真实 DSH child agent，模型请求走 DSH 原生 llm route。实现说明见 [pi2dsh 的 subagent bridge](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh#pi-host-abi-coverage)。

没有mcp的添加入口

nodes.body:
你观察得对：**当前 Web 设置页没有通用 MCP server 的添加表单**。现有入口是组合配置，而不是 GUI。

官方已经提供 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`，一个 server 对应一个插件实例。最安全的试用方式是先建一个临时 overlay：

```yaml
# my-mcp.cordis.yml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-example
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: example
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', '@example/mcp-server']
        env:
          EXAMPLE_TOKEN: !!js process.env.EXAMPLE_TOKEN
```

启动时加载：

```sh
dsh web --patch /absolute/path/to/my-mcp.cordis.yml
```

远程 Streamable HTTP server 则改成：

```yaml
config:
  serverName: example
  transport: streamable-http
  url: https://example.com/mcp
  headers:
    Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.MCP_TOKEN}`'
```

连接并完成 `tools/list` 后，模型看到的工具名是：

```text
mcp__example__<rawToolName>
```

确认临时配置能工作后，再把同一条 `insert` 合并到：

- 单个 profile：`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`
- 所有 profile：`$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`

不要覆盖已有 patch 文件，也不要把 token 明文写入 YAML；通过进程环境变量传入。

所以结论是：MCP runtime 能力已经存在，**缺的是便捷的配置 UI、校验与连接状态展示**。如果把它作为功能需求，我建议 GUI 至少覆盖 transport、command/args 或 URL、环境变量引用、连接测试、发现的工具数量、重连状态，以及删除前确认。

上游参考：[`dsh-mcp-client`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/main/packages/mcp/mcp-client) 和 [`examples/mcp-memory`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/main/examples/mcp-memory)。Handbook 也整理了 [MCP integration guide](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/integrations/mcp.md) 与 [connection troubleshooting](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/mcp-server-not-connecting.md)。

这个反馈需要按 transport 分开看。当前 `master` 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 已有连接 supervisor，默认配置是：

```yaml
reconnect:
  enabled: true
  initialDelayMs: 500
  maxDelayMs: 30000
  maxAttempts: 10
```

它由 2026-08-10 的 [`feat(mcp-client): auto-reconnect`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/00f68d7e9339105184d7f13dcf89a17ce80f3fe5) 引入；npm 的 `next` 当前是 `0.1.0-rc.6`。

不过这里有一个关键边界：

- **stdio server 进程退出/transport close**：会触发 supervisor，按退避策略新建 client + transport，并重新执行 `tools/list`。
- **Streamable HTTP 的会话或认证过期**：如果 SDK 只把它表现为某次请求失败，而没有触发 transport `onclose`，当前 supervisor 不会重新构造连接；源码的 Known limitations 也明确写的是 HTTP 不可达主要通过单次调用/SSE 恢复暴露。

所以“当时配置好能用，过期后不能用”更像第二条，不能笼统归为完全没有重连逻辑。为了形成可修复的复现，请补充：

1. `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --version`；
2. `transport: stdio` 还是 `streamable-http`；
3. 首次成功到失效经过多久，是否涉及 OAuth/token/session expiry；
4. 失效时 Host 日志里有没有 `connection lost; reconnecting`、`reconnected and re-synced tools` 或 `giving up after ...`；
5. 服务端返回的 HTTP 状态 / MCP error（token 请脱敏）。

若是 HTTP 401/403 或 session-id 失效且没有 `onclose`，修复点应是把可恢复的调用/会话错误升级为 transport generation 重建事件，并避免对有外部副作用的工具调用进行不安全的自动重放。临时方案是刷新凭证后 HMR 重载该插件实例，或重启 Host；不要直接重试一个结果未知的写操作。

补充一个容易遗漏的边界：当前缺少的是独立 MCP 图形化添加表单，底层能力属于 **Agent preset composition**，不是全局 Host 配置。一个 MCP server 对应一个 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row；工具只进入选择该 preset generation 的 Session。

所以配置后“仍然没有工具”时，先不要马上判定服务器没连上：

1. shipped preset 是只读集合，先创建 user preset copy，再编辑其中的 `agent.cordis.yml`；用户根默认由 Harness 派生为 `<DSH_HOME>/.agent-presets`。
2. 保存后新建一个 blank Session，并显式选择这个 preset。已经运行的 Session 会继续使用它启动时加入的旧 generation，不会在中途替换工具集合。
3. 工具公开名形如 `mcp__<serverName>__<rawName>`；`serverName` 在存活实例中必须唯一。
4. authoring 阶段可临时设置 `failOnStartupError: true`，让初始连接 / `listTools()` / 注册失败直接阻止 preset 激活；默认 `false` 时可能只记日志并以零工具继续。
5. stdio 要从 Host 账号核对 command、args、cwd、scrubbed env 和 stderr；Streamable HTTP 要从 Host 网络边界核对 URL、TLS、代理与认证，不是只看浏览器能否访问。

示例（token 从环境解析，不写进 YAML）：

```yaml
- id: mcp-internal-search
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"
  config:
    serverName: internal-search
    transport: streamable-http
    url: https://mcp.example.internal/mcp
    headers:
      Authorization: !!js "`Bearer ${process.env.MCP_TOKEN}`"
    failOnStartupError: true
```

完整英文指南包含 stdio/HTTP、generation、原子注册冲突、重连预算、preset 隔离和 7 步验收：
https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/deepseek-harness-mcp.html

说明：独立社区指南，按当前 rc.7 MCP client 与 agent-presets 源码核对，不代表官方 UI 路线图。
感谢确认！如果我的回复解决了你的问题，麻烦将其标记为 Answer，这样也方便之后遇到相同问题的用户快速找到解决方案。

为什么我的harness接入的多模态模型glm-4.6v无法识图

nodes.body:
这经常不是 glm-4.6v 本身不能看图，而是 GUI 准入按适配器声明的 `inputModalities` 拦。官方 deepseek 适配器会写成只有 text，选了视觉模型仍可能报「当前模型不支持图片」。同一条缝：#588 / #911 / #474。

[dsh-plugin-multimodal](https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal) 让 Web 先收下图：主模型本身收图就原样转发；纯文本主模型则 sidecar 转成字再发给它。

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal
```

重启 `dsh web`。`DSH_VISION_MODEL` 填真能看图的（例如你的 glm-4.6v），不要填 `deepseek-v4-flash`。

介绍：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1709

discussions.title: 对于文件路径的认识不足
技能的name应该支持中文
提案：把「一锅乱炖」的记忆拆成可挂载的「记忆体」插件
为什么一个 /goal 命令的目标，在完成时需要校验256轮是否完成？

nodes.body:
查了源码,这个 256 的出处是 dsh-goal 的配置默认值:

packages/goal/goal/src/index.ts:
```ts
static Config = z.object({ defaultMaxGoalRounds: z.number().default(256) })
```

**它不是什么"完成时校验 256 轮"**,而是:goal(目标)创建时如果没有显式指定 max_goal_rounds,自动续跑(autonomous continuation)轮数的**缺省上限**就是 256。含义是"这个目标最多自动接着干 256 轮",达到上限后停止自动续跑——不是每次完成都要校验 256 轮。

相关事实:
- 创建目标时可以显式设置 `max_goal_rounds`(例如 30),就会覆盖 256 这个缺省值
- 部署侧可以在 cordis 配置里改 `defaultMaxGoalRounds` 换掉缺省值
- 目标有 blocked(阻塞)机制:同一阻塞条件持续 3 轮以上才允许标记 blocked,这也不是"256 轮校验"

如果你看到的是界面上某个具体文案里的 256,把截图或原文贴出来,可以帮你确认它是不是这个缺省值。

discussions.title: 【效率反馈】agent 检索/工具使用效率：120s 超时的递归列目录命令 + 输入输出 token 冗余（附拆解与建议）

nodes.body:
The data matches our local micro-benchmark and the fix direction is right.

**Local benchmark (Windows, Node 24, PowerShell 7)**: `Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Depth 2 -File -Include *.md` on a clean tree completes in **4ms** ? so the 120s hang is not the command itself but what it walks into (symlink/junction cycles, network drives, huge dependency trees). The reliable fix is "don't use shell recursion for discovery", exactly as you said.

We shipped the reusable part: a **tools-first Retrieval contract** for AGENTS.md (Glob/Grep/Read over shell, node_modules excluded, offset/limit + head_limit, parallel batch reads, stable prompt prefix) ? tutorial with copy-paste snippet:

- zh: https://zoahdev.github.io/dsh-tutorials/zh-15-retrieval-efficiency.html
- en: https://zoahdev.github.io/dsh-tutorials/en-15-retrieval-efficiency.html

Supporting your guardrail asks: a default tool-output cap (bytes/lines with truncation marker) and a hint when a shell command looks like recursive directory listing would both prevent the 78KB-garbage-into-context class. Happy to help spec either.

[非官方] 你拆出的第 2 个问题（大段工具输出进入上下文并在后续步骤反复携带）现在有一条不改 Harness 源码的现成路径：`pi2dsh@0.11.0` 可以把 Pi 扩展直接挂到 DSH，配合 `pi-quiet-tools` 在 tool result 进入模型前压缩大结果，并把完整原文保存在可回读的本地 artifact。我们已经在真实 DSH 会话里验证过这条链路。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-quiet-tools
```

项目与验证材料：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh

边界也说清楚：它能直接挡住“78KB 垃圾输出继续污染后续上下文”，但不会让已经发出的 `Get-ChildItem -Recurse` 提前结束；递归检索优先 Glob/Grep/Read、避免走进 node_modules/坏链接，仍需要你文中第 1 条的检索策略或宿主侧命令护栏。两层一起做，才同时减少 120s 工具耗时和后续 token 重发。

discussions.title: [RFC / Proposal] Triple-Layer Persistent Memory (Markdown Rules + Vector Embeddings + Hybrid Vitality Ranking) for DeepSeek Harness

nodes.body:
This RFC's Layer 1 (Git-tracked Markdown rules) has a missing half: **where rules come from, and how they stay honest**. That half now exists as a running, verification-driven loop ? complementary, not competing:

**dsh-evolve** (https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-evolve, v0.4.0, MIT):
- `extract` / `reflect` ? rules are produced from failure logs and retrospectives automatically
- `verify` ? every rule is stamped by a real check (dsh-plugin-doctor, official tests, or any exit-0 command)
- `evolve_apply` ? verified rules install into AGENTS.md / MEMORY.md with backup; **unverified rules are refused**
- `audit` ? rule-library health: verified counts, near-duplicate detection, tag/source distribution
- plugin tools `evolve_learn` / `evolve_apply` so agents run the loop mid-session

Integration path with this RFC: `evolve_apply` can write its rendered block into `.dsh/MEMORY.md` instead of (or alongside) AGENTS.md ? your Layer 1 becomes the storage, ours the production + validation pipeline. The combination gives the ecosystem what memory alone cannot: **rules that can be trusted**.

@avaritiachaos happy to align storage format and dedup semantics. cc @imccyu @tianyicui ? a memory layer + a verification layer is the full answer to "lost lessons" without the "learned wrong lessons" problem.

@zoahdev Thanks for checking out our RFC!

That's an interesting complementary perspective. `@shion-lab/dsh-plugin-memory` is designed as an open, decoupled foundation: Layer 1 (`.dsh/MEMORY.md`) is deliberately plain Git-versioned Markdown so that any external pipeline (whether manual developer instructions, IDE hooks, or rule-verification loops like yours) can easily write standard structured blocks into it.

Once written, our Layer 2 & 3 (dense vector cosine index + 30-day half-life decay & frequency ranking) automatically handle the zero-bloat semantic recall and context budget injection for DeepSeek.

Feel free to format your outputs to match our schema! 🚀

discussions.title: Idea: Session-scoped plugin assembly — auto-install plugins for the task, clean up when the session ends
Concrete downstream use case for a pre-commit tool-input rewrite consistency seam
进行中的目标暂停不下来依然往目标前进
插件启动/重启与生态的几个问题与建议（附复现步骤）

nodes.body:
I checked items 1, 2, and 5 against master `47f9438`. The report identifies useful failure surfaces, with one important distinction for recovery.

For item 1, `dsh plugin` does not unconditionally replace `dsh.profile.bundles`. After pnpm succeeds, `reconcilePlugins()` compares the installed dependencies and their manifests:

- a dependency declaring `dsh.bundle.patch` is added;
- a dependency that was managed before but is now absent or no longer declares a bundle is removed;
- template bundles that are not dependency-managed are left untouched.

So the strongest reproduction should include the dependency diff, bundle list diff, and the installed manifests for the missing packages. That will show whether pnpm changed the dependency set, a package lost its bundle declaration, or reconciliation removed an entry outside its intended ownership.

For item 2, duplicate provider routes do fail atomically with `DUPLICATE_ADAPTER`. A provider route must have one runtime adapter owner. `registerConfigurableProviders()` is advisory settings/catalog metadata and is not an adapter override mechanism, so it cannot resolve a collision by itself. A third-party adapter needs a distinct route, or the original route owner must be removed from the composition.

For item 5, the service lifecycle documentation confirms that a required service belongs in `inject`. Without it, `ctx.get('settings')` is an optional lookup and the plugin must handle `undefined` at every use site. Silently skipping required namespace registration defers the failure to the client.

I turned these boundaries into a reversible operator runbook: preserve the manifest, lockfile, profile patch, and home patch; dump the composition before and after one install; then smoke test and either promote or restore the known-good state.

Visual runbook: https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/plugin-recovery.html

Canonical source guide: https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/pull/20

## 补充（2026-08-15）：会话存储布局不兼容 → 启动失败且错误归因误导（核心插件被误报）

新遇到一个关联问题，值得补充：

- **现象**：`sessions` 目录下出现 `_unknown-event-backup-*` 子目录，内含 6 个平铺（flat）`session.jsonl.zstd` 文件（官方返回 "unsupported flat session artifact inside project directory"）。workspace 后端拒绝读取，启动失败；但错误被归因成**核心插件 workspace 报错**（"插件 [workspace] 有错误"），恢复菜单因它是核心组件而拒绝自动禁用，用户卡死在恢复菜单里。
- **根因**：flat artifact 布局不被 workspace 后端支持（疑似备份/迁移工具产生的平铺产物）；同时启动失败的错误归因没有区分「插件错误」和「存储/数据布局错误」，把后者误报成前者。
- **建议**：
  1. workspace 后端对不支持的 flat artifact 给出可操作提示（或优雅跳过 + 日志警告），而不是让启动器把失败归因到插件；
  2. 启动失败归因区分「插件错误」与「数据/存储布局错误」两类，恢复策略也相应区分（数据问题不应尝试禁用核心插件）；
  3. 官方考虑支持或提供迁移/清理这类 flat session artifact 的工具。

## 补充 2（2026-08-15）：重启机制「委托交互式恢复流程」在非交互触发下必然失败

第 3 条（重启脚本杀后端会连带自杀）修复过程中又踩到关联坑，值得补充：

- **现象**：把重启动作交给「一次性计划任务」，helper 再去运行官方启动器；启动器遇到启动失败（例如会话存储布局问题）时会弹出**交互式恢复菜单**（`Read-Host` 等待输入数字选项）。在计划任务 / 无控制台环境里菜单无法被回答，重启进程被终止（任务结果 `0xC000013A`），后端保持关闭，没有任何自动恢复。
- **根因**：启动失败路径依赖「人工交互」；任何自动化 / 非交互触发器（计划任务、CI、远端）遇到失败都会卡死在这条路径上。
- **建议**：
  1. 启动器 / CLI 检测到非交互上下文（无控制台、`-NonInteractive`、stdin 非 TTY）时，恢复菜单自动降级：默认退出并把完整错误与下一步写进日志，而不是挂起等待输入；
  2. 重启 / 自动化入口走「直接拉起 + 就绪轮询」的纯非交互路径（复用 `node bin.js web` 的参数即可），不依赖交互式恢复；
  3. 失败时把「启动失败原因」与「可执行的恢复命令」写进明确日志，方便自动化或用户一次性处理。

第 2、5 条我们已做成可离线检测的检查并落地（[moonquake2004/dsh-doctor](https://github.com/moonquake2004/dsh-doctor)，commit `ef6ed30` + `587ff07`）：

- **P8**（profile）：扫描各 bundle 构建产物中的 `registerAdapter([...])`，检出**两个 bundle 抢注同一 provider** → 你的第 2 条（boot 时 `DUPLICATE_ADAPTER` 崩溃）的前置检测，输出冲突双方与修复建议（改用 `registerConfigurableProviders` 或只注册新路由）
- **P9**（profile）：`ctx.settings` / `ctx.get('settings')` 但 settings 依赖未声明（模块 `inject` 与 `ctx.inject` 均不含）→ 你的第 5 条问题模式，输出插件名与修复建议（加 `export const inject = ["settings"]` 或对可选服务做 undefined 处理）

实测中 P9 修了三轮防误报（`sctx.settings` 子串误匹配、bundle 里的 `client/` 浏览器端产物、bundle 内**首个** inject 数组被误当作插件自身的），现在 59/59 测试全绿；对真实 profile 实测干净通过。

两点呼应：
- 你的第 2 条建议"启动预检能提前拦截"正是这类检查的定位——`dsh doctor` 或本工具跑 `--profile` 即可在 boot 前看到 P8；
- 你的第 4 条启动器 preflight 若想直接消费诊断结果，我们 0.2.5 的 `dsh-doctor/v1` 信封输出（#1719 已与 dsh-plugin-doctor 对齐）可直接被启动器解析，无需再解析文本。

第 1、3 条（plugin add 合并语义、重启脚本进程树）属上游/launcher 层，我们没法从离线侧覆盖，但赞同你的建议方向。

## 补充 3（2026-08-15）：实测确认「后端 spawn 的 detached 重启进程也会随后端一起死」

对第 3 条做了一次真机实测（同一 Windows 环境）：

- **现象**：`dsh-service-control` 的「重启服务」按钮用 Node `spawn(pwsh, …, { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' }) + unref()` 安排重启，再 `appExit(0)` 退出。实测：按钮触发后后端退出、页面断连，但重启 helper **没有产生任何启动日志**（node 的 stdout/stderr 重定向文件都没有被创建），后端保持关闭 → 只能手动启动。
- **结论（本机 Windows 实测）**：由**后端进程**发起的 `spawn(detached: true)` **并不保证脱离后端的进程树 / Job**——后端一退出，helper 也随之消失，重启必然失败。`detached` 只脱离进程组 / 控制台，不脱离 Job Object。
- **可用的解法（已验证）**：交给**真正独立于后端进程树**的执行者——Windows 一次性计划任务（Task Scheduler）最可靠；已验证「计划任务 → 直接 `node bin.js web` 拉起 → HTTP 200 就绪」全程自动化成功。
- **建议**：官方文档明确「由后端触发的进程可能随后端一起终止（尤其 Windows Job Object）」，并提供 / 推荐可靠的进程外重启通道。

插件启动/重启的问题集（每条带复现+根因）——dsh plugin add 静默问题、重启状态等，和第 3 章依赖/挂载坑是同一片区域。

这些根因值得并进第 3 章，方便的话可以整理成 checklist 我来收录：https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook/blob/main/docs/03-profiles.md

@Electricitysheep — Here's the full problem set from this thread, organized as a checklist for **3.5 常见坑** (all eight entries, each attributed to who verified it — I only vouch for the two we have offline detection for; the rest carry their verifier's name so you can decide what to include):

**1. `dsh plugin add` does not unconditionally replace `dsh.profile.bundles`** — *verified by sandbaseai against master 47f9438*
- Root cause: after pnpm succeeds, `reconcilePlugins()` diffs installed dependencies vs manifests: a dep declaring `dsh.bundle.patch` is added; a previously-managed dep that is now absent or no longer declares a bundle is removed; template bundles not dependency-managed are left untouched.
- Repro (strongest form): capture the dependency diff + bundle-list diff + installed manifests for the missing packages — that shows whether pnpm changed the dep set, a package lost its bundle declaration, or reconciliation removed an entry outside its intended ownership.
- Runbook: sandbaseai published a reversible operator runbook (preserve manifest/lockfile/patches → dump composition before/after one install → smoke test → promote or restore): [visual](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/plugin-recovery.html) / [source](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/issues/20).

**2. Duplicate adapter registration → boot-time `DUPLICATE_ADAPTER` crash** — *sandbaseai (master check) + our P8 (offline detection)*
- Root cause: a provider route must have exactly one runtime adapter owner; `registerConfigurableProviders()` is advisory settings/catalog metadata, not an adapter override mechanism.
- Detection: our P8 scans each bundle's build output for `registerAdapter([...])` and flags two bundles claiming the same provider, before boot (`dsh-doctor --profile`, since 0.2.6) — this generalizes the #1415/#1827 tool-cordis callout already in your 3.5 into a detectable rule.
- Fix: third-party adapter registers a distinct route, or the original route owner is removed from the composition.

**3. Restart path can kill the backend it was spawned from** — *OP's real-machine tests (Windows)*
- Root cause: `spawn(..., { detached: true })` from the backend only escapes the process group/console — it does **not** escape the Windows Job Object; when the backend exits, the restart helper dies with it (verified: no helper logs produced, backend stays off).
- Verified working alternative: Windows one-shot Task Scheduler → `node bin.js web` → HTTP-200 readiness poll.
- Fix direction: out-of-process restart channel + docs clarifying backend-triggered processes may die with the backend.

**4. Interactive recovery menu hangs in non-interactive contexts** — *OP*
- Root cause: startup failure path prompts a `Read-Host` menu; under a scheduled task / CI / no-TTY it can't be answered, the process is terminated (0xC000013A), backend stays off with no auto-recovery.
- Fix direction: detect non-interactive context (no console / `-NonInteractive` / stdin non-TTY) → degrade to "exit + log full error and next steps"; automation should use direct launch + readiness polling.

**5. Startup failure misattributed to the core `workspace` plugin** — *OP*
- Root cause: flat session artifacts (`_unknown-event-backup-*` with flat `session.jsonl.zstd`, "unsupported flat session artifact inside project directory") are refused by the workspace backend, but the launcher reports it as a plugin error and the recovery menu won't disable a core component → user is stuck.
- Fix direction: distinguish "plugin error" from "data/storage layout error" in attribution and recovery; backend gives an actionable hint or gracefully skips + logs; official tooling to migrate/clean flat artifacts.

**6. `ctx.settings` used without declaring the dependency** — *sandbaseai (master check) + our P9 (offline detection)*
- Root cause: a required service belongs in `inject`; without it `ctx.get('settings')` is an optional lookup and the plugin must handle `undefined` at every use site — silently skipping registration defers the failure to the client.
- Detection: our P9 flags `ctx.settings` / `ctx.get('settings')` reads whose module `inject` and `ctx.inject` lack `"settings"` (hardened through three false-positive rounds: `sctx.settings` substring, browser-side `client/` bundles, first-inject-array confusion; current fixture corpus 87 tests), `dsh-doctor --profile`.
- Fix: `export const inject = ["settings"]`, or treat the service as optional and handle `undefined`.

**7. Launcher preflight can consume diagnostics directly** — *our lane*
- If a startup preflight wants to consume diagnostic results, the `dsh-doctor/v1` envelope (`{ok, checks:[{name,status,detail}]}`, lowercase status, exit 0/1/2) is machine-parseable — no text scraping needed; aligned with dsh-plugin-doctor and dsh-diagnose (#1719).

**8. `--env`-side gap (offline probes don't cover runtime internals)** — worth a note, not a failure: sandbox denials / approval policy have no direct offline probe today; check commands honestly read session logs / config instead.

Want this as a PR to `docs/03-profiles.md` (I'd fit 1–6 into 3.5 with per-row 帖号, 7 as a pointer under the launcher/auto-recovery discussion), or is the inline checklist enough?

nodes.body:
能接,机制是开放的,只是官方教程还没写透。设置卡片的底层是 settings 域的 slot 体系(dsh-client-ui-settings):

- 注册面:`ctx.settingsScope.bind(spec)` 绑定你插件的命名空间,slot 类型里有 `settings.section`(每个功能一页)和 `settings.plugins.tab`(插件区里功能自有的页)——第三方插件注册的入口就是这两个
- 渲染面:dsh-client-schema-form 负责把 host 侧的 Config schema(schemastery)变成表单;写入走 Host transport,持久化到 settings.yaml(dsh-settings host 侧)
- 第三方完整接入 = 两半:host 插件定义 Config schema + client 插件(package.json 里 dsh.client 声明,web 平台,注入 connection/settingsScope)注册 section/tab 并用 SchemaForm 渲染

可抄的实现:
1. 官方 `dsh-client-ui-plan-execute`(设置页里给 plan/execute 加设置行的最小结构)
2. 社区 `dsh-custom-css`(粘贴 CSS 即时生效、持久化 settings.yaml 的完整链路)

两个坑提前说:
- settings RPC 是 **loopback-only**(README 明文):远程浏览器里这些设置页直接不可用,别指望局域网配置
- host Config 记得用 schemastery Schema 而不是手写校验,否则表单生成不出来

如果社区需要,我可以把这个"设置卡片"模板加进 dsh-plugin-starter 脚手架(host Config + client section + SchemaForm 三件套),让新插件开箱带设置页。

兑现上一条的承诺:dsh-plugin-starter 已随 030fb16 发布源码级设置卡片指南。

- 指南:https://github.com/ciceroyang/dsh-plugin-starter/blob/main/docs/settings-guide.md(机制总览 / host 半免构建 / client 半 tsdown / 四个坑)
- host 示例:https://github.com/ciceroyang/dsh-plugin-starter/blob/main/examples/settings-host-config.js(schemastery Config 骨架)

关键结论供你直接判断:
1. host 半现在就能做(纯 JS + Schema)
2. client 半要 tsdown + React(slot 注册形态照官方 ui-settings-models 抄,我已把最小结构提炼进指南)
3. settings RPC 是 loopback-only——远程浏览器的设置页不可用(和 #1733 是同一个护栏)

等 rc 期 settings 注册面稳定后,我会把 client 侧做成 --with-settings 模板内建进脚手架。

dsh-plugin-starter 3ba820d 已发布 `--with-settings` 变体:设置卡片 client 模板内建。

- 生成内容:client/index.tsx(settings.section 注册 + 最小表单,描 settings.describe → 写 settings.update 的数据通路)+ dsh.client manifest + tsdown 构建脚本/依赖
- 用法:`node generator.mjs my-plugin --with-settings`,之后 `pnpm install && pnpm build`
- 边界照旧:render thunk 的注入面按官方 ui-settings-models 抄结构,适配 rc 版差异;settings RPC loopback-only,远程浏览器无设置页
- 7/7 测试,CI 四版本

加上此前的 host 示例(examples/settings-host-config.js)和源码级指南(docs/settings-guide.md),host/client/构建三件套齐了。有需要调整的点欢迎直接提 issue。

有个可能不算bug的bug，这里简单反馈下吧

npm安装命令 ，ubuntu 提示bug   ，cc审查：
问题确认了：系统的 node-gyp（apt 包）缺失核心的 Python 库（gyp 模块），这是 Ubuntu 24.04 上这个包的已知 bug。修复方法是用 npm 装一个完整的 node-gyp 并让 npm 使用它

这个不是 DSH 的 bug,是 Ubuntu 24.04 的 apt 版 node-gyp 缺 Python gyp 模块的已知问题(DSH 依赖的原生模块需要 node-gyp 参与安装)。

修复两步:

```bash
# 1. 补齐编译与 Python 依赖(最常缺的就是这个)
sudo apt install -y python3 make g++
# 2. 用 npm 的完整版 node-gyp 替代系统包
npm install -g node-gyp
```

然后重新执行你的安装命令即可。若还报同样的错,加 `--foreground-scripts` 看完整编译日志,把 gyp 的具体报错贴出来可以继续定位。

顺带:装完可以跑一下社区体检工具 dsh-doctor(https://github.com/ciceroyang/dsh-doctor),node/pnpm/编译环境类问题它会直接给出可执行的修复建议。

discussions.title: 关于模型切换的建议

nodes.body: 下面两张是我修改后自己使用时的截图

[非官方] 你列的 1–3 项里，“含历史图片的会话继续交给文本模型”现在已经有一条不改 Harness 源码的可用路径。`pi2dsh@0.11.0` 会为文本 route 生成一个 `<原路由>-vision` 伴生路由：它对 DSH 声明可接收图片，先让独立视觉模型把历史图片转成文字证据，再从发给原文本模型的消息树里递归剥离 image block；原始附件仍留在 DSH append-only 会话里。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision

export VISION_BRIDGE_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
export VISION_BRIDGE_MODEL=qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
export VISION_BRIDGE_API_KEY=your-openrouter-key

dsh web
```

在 Web 模型选择器里选对应的 **+ Vision Bridge** 分组即可。我们已用真实 DSH Web 会话验证：历史有图片，最终主调用仍是 DeepSeek 文本模型，视觉分析只作为文本上下文注入；切回视觉链时原附件仍可用。项目与证据：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh

这条中间层路径不会向模型写入“当前模型看不了图”之类的能力判断，正好避免你第 2 条说的上下文污染。你第 3/4 项的 UI-only 警告和“下一轮实际换模”时间线仍应由 Harness 客户端实现；pi2dsh 目前不把这两个界面细节冒充已解决。

discussions.title: Plugin compatibility report: dsh-mneme flagged high-risk due to static-scan false positive

nodes.body:
Confirmed: this exact false-positive class bit our own static check too. `dsh-plugin-doctor`'s `pre-execute-side-effects` lint matched bare `exec(` ? so `db.exec('CREATE TABLE ...')` (node:sqlite `DatabaseSync.exec`, pure SQL) was flagged as shell execution. Same heuristic-blindness you describe.

We just shipped the fix (v1.10.2): the pattern now matches `spawn|execFile|execSync|fork` only, with a regression test that asserts `db.exec(...)` + `db.prepare(...).run(...)` do NOT trigger. 28/28 tests, doctor passes its own check: https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor/releases/tag/v1.10.2

Lessons that transferred:
1. Bare method-name matching is too broad ? match the API shape (import source + call site), not just the name.
2. Exclude tests/fixtures from scans (they legitimately simulate violations).
3. Make the pattern not match its own source text.

For dsh.so's scanner: adding a node:sqlite allowlist (`DatabaseSync.exec` / `prepare().run()` are SQL, not shell) would fix the whole class at the source.

discussions.title: [Feature Request] 历史消息含图片时，允许切换到纯文本模型 / Allow switching image-containing sessions to text-only models

nodes.body:
技术原因很直接：会话里已存在的 image content block 要求当前模型具备视觉能力；切成纯文本模型后，历史消息里的图片块会变成该模型不支持的输入，provider 直接报错。

现在的可行路径：

1. **新会话 + 引用文件**：开新会话切文本模型，用 @file / 附件引用代替图片块（社区插件 dsh-at-file 就是这个模式），历史图片不再进上下文。
2. **压缩后再切**：先触发一次 compaction，把带图的会话压成文本摘要，再切文本模型——摘要里不再有图片块。
3. **继续用视觉模型但降低视觉开销**：如果只是偶尔看图，保留视觉模型但把图片引用改成"按需加载"，而不是每轮都带。

值得做的官方改进：**模型切换时检测历史图片块并给出选项**（"切换到纯文本模型将剥离 N 个图片块，历史图片将以附件引用保留，确认？"），剥离而不是报错。这个交互成本很低，PR 通道开了可以提。

这个切换场景现在有一个不改 DeepSeek Harness core 的可用解法：[`pi2dsh@0.11.0`](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 会给每条 text-only route 自动注册同模型目录的 `<route>-vision` 伴生路由。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
```

重启后，模型选择器里会出现 **DeepSeek + Vision Bridge** 分组。需要从带图历史切到 `deepseek-v4-flash` 时，不选原始 DeepSeek 分组里的 Flash，而选伴生分组里的同一个 Flash：

- 伴生模型对 Harness 目录声明可接收 image，因此 `selectModel` 的历史图片检查可以通过；
- 真正调用模型前，它会递归扫描本次请求的**完整消息历史**，把 image block（包括嵌套 tool-result 里的图片）替换成文字标记；能物化附件时标记里带本地文件路径；
- 然后把纯文本消息转发给原始 `deepseek-v4-flash` route，所以像素不会进入 DeepSeek 文本 adapter，provider/model 也没有被伪装成另一套传输。

如果后续还要继续理解新图片，可再装 `@kassing/pi-vision` 自动转描述，或 `pi-vision-tool` 让 Agent 按需调用；如果像原帖所说“图片阶段已经处理完”，只装 pi2dsh、切伴生分组就能完成降级切换。

真实 Web 复现、公开视觉端点配置和截图：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/vision-bridge

更新：8 月 21 日发布的 `v0.1.1-rc.2` 已经实现了本帖建议的核心功能：允许通过请求期临时降级，将带图历史会话切换到纯文本模型。纯文本请求会把历史图片临时替换为文字占位符；切回视觉模型后，原始图片仍会重新进入请求。

继续测试时发现两个可以优化的地方：图片被降级时用户没有明确感知；切回视觉模型后，当前模型也可能被上一轮纯文本模型的回答带偏。相关设计、对比截图和参考实现整理在新的 Discussion：<(https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4188)>

discussions.title: [Bug] web 会话无正式途径开启 web_fetch 工具

nodes.body:
这个场景现在可以不改 preset、也不用自己拼 `dsh-web-fetch-http` 依赖：Pi 生态现成的 [`@juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools) 可以通过 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 原包挂到 DSH，直接注册 `web_fetch` 和 `web_search`。

```sh
# Pi Host ABI 兼容引擎只装一次
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0

# Pi 插件保持 npm 原包，不转换、不改源码
dsh plugin --profile web add @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools
```

重启 `dsh web` 后：

- `web_fetch` 无需 key，可直接抓公开 HTTP(S) 页面；
- `web_search` 可运行 `/web-tools` 选择 Brave/Tavily/Serper/Exa/Jina/SearXNG/Ollama 等后端，或直接设置对应环境变量；
- 它自带 SSRF 边界：拒绝 private/loopback/metadata 地址，长网页截断并把全文落临时文件供 Agent 按需读取。

这条不是只验证了“能加载”：我们在真实 DSH runtime 里执行过 `web_fetch` 抓取 `example.com`，也跑过真实 `web_search` 工具链。复现证据在 [`community/runtime-results.json`](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/blob/main/community/runtime-results.json)。

因此对“Web 会话需要正式可用的全文抓取工具”这个用户场景，它已经是一个无需改 DSH 源码的可安装方案。

感谢推荐，这个方案很实用：`pi2dsh` + `@juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools` 两条命令即可装好，不用改 preset、不用手拼依赖，还自带 SSRF 边界——这些优点我们都确认属实，确实比我报告里的手拼方案省事。

不过想说明一下本帖的定位：**这个帖子主要是向官方上报 bug 与修复方案**，核心诉求不在安装方法，而在于：

1. **根因**：`web_fetch` 工具代码在 `dsh-tool-web` 内完整内置、注册逻辑齐全，但产品没有任何正式途径能开启它——无默认挂载的 fetch 提供方、预设层 `fetch: false`、提供方不在运行时模块闭包内。
2. **修复方案**（已实施并验收，部署级、不动源码）：自包含插件目录挂载 + 宿主 patch `insert` + 用户预设开启 `fetch`。
3. **上游建议**：希望官方把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 纳入 `apps/cli` 运行时依赖，并在 `standard` 预设提供 `fetch` 开关（或至少在文档写明开启方式），让 `web_fetch` 有一个正式开启途径。

Pi 生态方案作为社区现成的绕行方案可以并存、也很有价值；但原生「能力存在、缺开启途径」的缺口仍在，期待官方评估修复。

discussions.title: 【建议】纯文本模型收到图片时提供“落盘+文字标记”回退，便于子 Agent / 视觉脚本接管

nodes.body: 顶

这扇门确实在准入层：纯文本模型（如 Flash）贴图会被 `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` 直接拒，图不落盘，后面的视觉脚本 / 子 Agent 都接不到。

官方若把 `imageFallback: store-and-annotate` 收进 web 网关最好。在那之前，插件侧可以先把门打开——只做受理：贴图落成本地路径 / attachment，主模型仍是纯文本，不把 `input: [text, image]` 当成官方 chat-completions 已解锁，也不是 `vision_*` / `read_image` 工具箱。

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal
```

装完要重启 `dsh web`。说明在 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1709

这个场景现在也有一条已经跑通的插件方案，而且不只做到“落盘+标记”：[`pi2dsh@0.11.0`](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 会为每条纯文本模型路由自动注册独立的 `<route>-vision` 伴生路由，在伴生路由上完成图片准入、附件物化和发往文本 adapter 前的图片块剥离，不修改原始 DeepSeek 路由的能力声明。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision
```

重启后在模型选择器里选择 **DeepSeek + Vision Bridge** 分组，Web 可以直接粘贴图片。后续有两种完整链路：

1. `@kassing/pi-vision` 在 `before_agent_start` 自动调用配置的视觉模型，把识图结果作为 DSH context injection 注入，纯文本 DeepSeek 直接基于描述回答；
2. 安装 `pi-vision-tool` 时，Agent 按需调用 `describe_image`；没有这两个包时，已有的 MCP/skill/script 只要能读文件路径，也能接到物化后的图片路径。

我们已经在真实 DSH Web loop 验证过：粘贴蓝色测试图 → 自动视觉分析注入 → `deepseek-v4-flash` 一轮、零工具直答 `blue`。安装、公开视觉端点配置和截图都在 [完整演示 #2040](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2040)。

所以这条建议里的用户工作流目前可以不改 core 先完整使用；core 将来提供统一入站钩子，插件实现会更薄。

感谢各位指路，来更新一下这条建议的落地情况：

我们已经按 `dsh-vision-proxy`（Flyvhidbwo）的方案跑通了：`deepseek-vision` 伴生路由设为默认，DeepSeek 负责全部文字推理，图片经 OpenAI 兼容端点转写后合并进对话。实测 web 直发图、转写、作答全链路正常，配置几分钟完成。

说实话有点过意不去——两位作者亲自来指路，两位的成果我们却没有实际用上。但这纯属时间上的巧合：动手安装时我们先看到了 dsh-vision-proxy 的 README，装完验证通过就留了下来，并不是把各家方案摆在一起比较之后的取舍，更不是两位方案有什么不足。

两位的方案我其实都仔细读过：
- `dsh-plugin-multimodal` 零运行时依赖、代码极简克制，在 adapter 层把整件事收敛得干净利落；
- `pi2dsh` 不改动原路由的能力声明，还把 Pi 生态的兼容层做成了完整体系，注入式识图和按需工具两条链路都配了完整演示，工程深度明显更深。

社区里三条路线并存，各自在适配层、伴生路由、桥接层找了不同的切入点，恰好都落在同一个问题上——图片入站缺少统一的预处理挂点。如果 core 将来提供官方 ingress hook，这类插件都能简化不少。再次感谢两位，也期待官方早点把这扇门开进 core。

discussions.title: [Feature Request] MCP 客户端缺少 OAuth 2.0 支持（PKCE/动态注册/令牌刷新），无法直连强制 OAuth 的远程 MCP 服务器（如 Atlassian Remote MCP）——工程化必需

nodes.body:
MCP 缺 OAuth 2.0（PKCE/动态注册/令牌刷新）——远程 MCP 服务器强制 OAuth 的越来越多（Atlassian 这类），纯静态请求头确实不够工程化。

MCP 接入的工程边界第 9 章有讨论，OAuth 是下一块要补的：https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook/blob/main/docs/09-mcp-subagent-workflow.md

To help discovery for English-speaking people and agents, here is a google translate dump of the original post.

> Issue
> Currently, `dsh-mcp-client` supports only `stdio` or `streamable-http` transport mechanisms alongside static request headers; it completely lacks OAuth 2.0 client capabilities (missing Authorization Code + PKCE flows, RFC 8414 discovery, RFC 7591 dynamic client registration, and token storage/refresh mechanisms; source code `lib/index.js` confirms that plugin injection is limited to `['tools']`).
> 
> However, by 2026, official remote MCP servers will essentially mandate OAuth (e.g., Atlassian Remote MCP / `mcp.atlassian.com` returns `401 + WWW-Authenticate`), rendering `dsh` unable to directly connect to any such official MCPs. Reproduction
> Configuring `mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp` (streamable-http) in `cordis.patch.yml` results in a 401 Unauthorized error; static headers cannot complete the authorization code flow.
> One is forced to build a custom local bridge server (I personally wrote ~600 lines of bridging code—handling OAuth auth code, PKCE, dynamic registration, token refreshing, and tool forwarding—to work around this gap), effectively shifting functionality that *should* be built-in onto the user.
> Expectation
> Implement a built-in OAuth 2.0 client following the OAuth Authorization section of the MCP specification (modelcontextprotocol/specification):
> 
> Authorization Code + PKCE (S256)
> RFC 8414 Authorization Server Discovery (`.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`)
> RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration (`registration_endpoint`)
> Local callback (`localhost` redirect) or Device Flow with browser-based authorization
> Token persistence (file mode `0600`) and automatic refreshing; automatic re-authorization upon receiving a 401 error
> Reference implementation: `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` v1.30 includes a built-in `OAuthClientProvider` (this project already depends on this SDK), and Claude Code follows the same pattern.
> Engineering Value
> Many official remote MCPs used within enterprises (Atlassian Jira/Confluence, GitHub, Slack, etc.) mandate OAuth; the inability of DSH—as an engineering-grade agent harness—to connect means critical business data (tickets, PRs, documentation) remains inaccessible.
> Without built-in OAuth, every user must build their own bridge, incurring high security and maintenance costs.
> This is an essential capability for "production-grade engineering and real-world use cases"; implementation is highly recommended as a priority.

Also, +1 :)

这个场景现在可以不再自建 OAuth 转发桥。我们已经用 `pi2dsh` 把原版
`pi-mcp-adapter` 作为普通 DSH 插件能力包接入，插件仍然自己负责 MCP
transport、OAuth、缓存和刷新；pi2dsh 只把它的公开 Host ABI 翻译到 DSH 的
commands、userQuestions、tools 与模型调用链。

安装仍然只用 DSH 官方插件命令：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-mcp-adapter
```

重启后，在标准 `.mcp.json` 中声明远程服务器（例如 Atlassian 的
`https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2`，`auth: "oauth"`），然后在 dsh-TUI
或 Web 执行：

```text
/mcp-auth atlassian
```

刚完成的真实验收不是 mock：Atlassian 授权服务器发现、动态客户端注册、PKCE、
浏览器 localhost 回调、安全凭证存储、MCP 重连与 26 个工具发现全部通过；随后
DeepSeek 在 DSH Web 和 dsh-TUI 中都真实调用了只读的
`atlassian_atlassianUserInfo`，持久会话日志里的 `tool/result` 为
`isError:false`。正常本机回调会自动完成并撤掉粘贴框；只有 SSH/跨机器浏览器无法
访问回调端口时才需要手动粘贴 URL。`/pi-mcp logout atlassian` 会清除凭证。

这是一条现在即可安装的生态兼容路径，不代表官方 `dsh-mcp-client` 已被修改；后续
官方原生 OAuth 完善后，两条路径可以按需要替换。

项目与复现步骤：

- https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh
- https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/tui-mcp

discussions.title: 【Core 实现】纯文本主模型贴图不再被拒：工作区镜像 + vision bridge + 信任边界修复

nodes.body:
core 层实现贴图（工作区镜像 + vision bridge + 信任边界）——社区一直在讨论区提（#1378/#1327 都是），终于有 core 实现落地了。

视觉桥家族从插件（#1153/#1269）进化到 core 层，生态正循环的信号。已收录进手册生态章节：https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook/blob/main/docs/07-ecosystem.md
不客气，core 实现很扎实，期待后续。

**更新（2026-08-16）：分支已 rebase 到官方最新 rc.8（`141eb6f`）**

官方 master 在 rc.5 → rc.8 期间推进了 647 个 commit（含 `feat(llm-deepseek): support multimodal requests`、`feat(attachment): add ordered image batch admission` 等图片相关改动），我把两个 commit 手工 rebase 并合并冲突后推到了 fork：

- `master` → 与官方 rc.8 完全同步（`141eb6f`）
- `feat/image-upload-vision-bridge` → rc.8 + 2 commits（`e4c782b` + `b3aa116`），ahead 2

**rebase 中处理的情况：**

1. **信任边界修复（commit 1）**：官方 rc.8 依然没有修 Chrome/Edge 扩展场景的 Origin 省略端口问题（`api-request-trust.ts` 0 次改动），补丁干净应用、无冲突。
2. **vision bridge + 工作区镜像（commit 2）**：官方 rc.8 实现了**多模态 data-URL 直发**（给支持图片的模型用），但**纯文本模型场景的 `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` 拒绝逻辑原封不动**——vision bridge 逃生通道在官方代码里依然不存在，属纯增量。3 个冲突文件（serialize.ts / api-proxy.ts / InputBar.tsx）已手工合并：
   - 保留你的镜像 + bridge 逻辑
   - 融合官方新增的 `admitEncodedImages`（attachment 批量受理）与 `serializeImageAdmission`（受理串行化）
   - 测试 stub 补齐官方 rc.8 新增的 `saveImages` 接口
3. **测试验证**：apiproxy + serialize + trust 相关 441 个测试全绿；你的文件类型检查通过（typecheck 全量报错均来自官方 rc.8 自带的 agent-team / pwsh 模块，与本次改动无关）。

**结论不变**：官方 rc.8 的多模态支持解决"有眼睛的模型"，本实现解决"纯文本模型 + 社区视觉工具"——两者互补，vision bridge 依然是社区提案（#2005 store-and-annotate / #1378 host 层降级）的官方层落地。

获取方式更新：

```sh
git fetch https://github.com/gloryxpnv/deepseek-harness.git feat/image-upload-vision-bridge
git checkout feat/image-upload-vision-bridge
```

补充一份独立的 rc.8 验证，聚焦本帖的信任边界修复部分：

- 本地已快进到官方 `master` / `dsh-v0.1.0-rc.8`：`141eb6fef83422698aef7a981029e843e8161534`；
- `api-request-trust.ts`、`rpc-host.ts` 与对应测试在 rc.8 中仍未修改，原始 `.host ===` 精确端口比较依然存在；
- Chrome 实际 POST 请求捕获为 `Host: 127.0.0.1:3080`、`Origin: http://127.0.0.1`、`Referer: http://127.0.0.1:3080/`、`Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin`；
- 影响范围是共享 `/api` 下的全部 HTTP RPC，不只是 `host.pickDirectory`。静态前端可以加载，但 `host.describe`、会话/工作区、设置、凭据与模型发现等都在分发前被 403。

本地采用了比“所有情况只比较 hostname”更窄的回环兼容分支：仅当 Host 为 loopback、Origin 同 hostname 且无端口、Fetch Metadata 为 `same-origin`，并且 Referer 精确绑定实际 Host 端口时放行。这样不会把非回环 `trustedHosts` 的精确端口语义一起放宽，也继续拒绝 `Origin: null`、跨站、错误 Referer 端口等形状。

在 rc.8 基线上重新执行：

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`：通过；
- `pnpm run build`：通过；
- connection tests：10 files / 111 tests 通过；
- 使用上述真实请求头组合探测 `/api/host.describe`：修复后 HTTP 200。

因此你在分支更新里所说的“rc.8 仍未修复、补丁可干净应用”与独立检查一致。建议若继续维护 trust-only commit，可考虑加入 Referer 精确端口约束，作为比全局 hostname-only 更小的安全兼容面。主问题的最新复现证据也已同步到 #2009。

discussions.title: 自称万物都是插件的dsh无法替换pwsh

nodes.body:
替换 pwsh 卡在权限系统——bash 替换涉及沙箱/权限联动（工具与权限强绑定），确实不是改配置就能切。

改 base bundle 的思路对（一处生效），但要注意权限模型的联动。第 13 章权限模型有讨论：https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook/blob/main/docs/13-security.md

这一步不用改部署自带的代码。**插件包可以带自己的 `cordis.patch.yml`**，patch 是可以叠加的，所以你能从外部关掉 stock 行，升级也不会被覆盖。

在你的插件 `package.json` 里声明。

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" }
  }
}
```

然后在那个文件里按 id 关掉 stock 行，再插入你自己的。

```yaml
- id: subprocess
  disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
- insert:
    - id: subprocess-windows
      name: 'dsh-win32'
      disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
```

这是 `dsh-win32` 现在在用的东西，原样贴出来。我们要换掉的是 subprocess 运行时而不是 `tool-pwsh`，但机制完全一样，把 `id` 换成 `tool-pwsh` 就是你要的。`!!js` 表达式让它只在特定平台生效，其他平台保留官方行，所以同一个包在三个系统上装都安全。

两点值得说清楚。

**关于权限系统的联动，@Electricitysheep 说得对，但它不挡这条路。** 权限确实和工具强绑定，不过绑定的是 bundle 解析之后的那份 roster。patch 在更早的层，你换进去的行拿到的是同一套权限接线，不是绕过它。我们换掉的是整个 subprocess 运行时（PTY、信号、沙箱路径全在里面），沙箱模式照常生效，`workspace-write` 该限制的一样限制。所以「换 shell 会破坏权限模型」这个担心，至少在这个层面上不成立。

**能不能真的换掉 bash 是另一个问题，跟插件机制无关。** 我们在这上面花了不少时间，结论是 Windows 上 MSYS 系的 shell 在 `workspace-write` 的受限令牌下启动即死，实测两个签名，`cygheap_user::init: NtSetInformationToken (TokenDefaultDacl), 0xC0000022` 和 `CreateFileMapping ... Win32 error 5`（[#1613](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1613) 里有第三方的同族报告）。这堵墙在插件层无解，换成没有 POSIX 模拟层的 busybox-w32 ash 才能活下来。如果你换 shell 的目的是在沙箱里用，这个坑先知道比较省时间。

机制本身是好的。「万物皆插件」在这件事上是真的，只是 `cordis.patch.yml` 能被第三方包携带这件事没怎么写在文档里。

discussions.title: 显式说明 web_search 搜索模型使用：搜索结果卡片显示实际计费模型，设置卡片可配置搜索模型
Feature request: per-project (workspace) default agent preset and model
Proposal: add real-host release lifecycle validation to the plugin-development Skill / 建议增加真实宿主发布门禁

nodes.body:
Follow-up evidence: [`dsh-testkit@0.3.1`](https://github.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit/releases/tag/v0.3.1) applies this proposed boundary to a real public template repository root.

The first root run exposed two runner defects that source-only and synthetic fixtures had not revealed: Git-resolution logs were retained but absent from the strict report artifact set, and legitimate `prepare` output could precede the final `npm pack --json` array. Both were fixed fail-closed in [PR #13](https://github.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit/pull/13), then the released public package passed package → install → assemble → boot → register → deterministic exercise → uninstall → reboot → cleanup against the template.

The adoptable integration is open at [bugmaker2/dsh-plugin-template#1](https://github.com/bugmaker2/dsh-plugin-template/pull/1). Its generated project Skill, exact scenario, and least-privilege Action show how the vendor-neutral text above can become a default Agent/release habit without making Testkit an official dependency.

中文补充：把门禁真正接入公开模板后确实发现了仅靠源码测试和合成 fixture 没暴露的问题；v0.3.1 修复后，公共 npm 产物已在模板仓库根目录完整通过。这也说明官方 Skill 或插件教程中加入“测试实际打包产物、卸载后重启并保留证据”是一个独立且有现实价值的边界。

@iiwish — a real-world instance of the "in-host tool can't diagnose a host that fails before the tool registers" thesis, with a kernel-gap finding worth folding into the release-gate direction.

**The case:** our plugin (`@moonquake2004/dsh-doctor`) shipped with a `cordis.patch.yml` insert `name` and a client `__ModuleLoader__.load` registration id that used the bare `dsh-doctor` instead of the scoped package name. Under a scoped install the loader threw `failed to import loader entry … : Cannot find package 'dsh-doctor'` / `client-modules: bundle …/client.js loaded without registering "@moonquake2004/dsh-doctor"` → **the whole dsh web boot died, and stayed dead** (restart npx didn't help; only a manual edit of client.js + restart recovered it). Two-line fix, now pinned by a regression test + shipped in 0.3.4.

**The kernel gap this exposes:** reading the harness source, there is **no self-heal** for a boot-time plugin-registration failure:
- `reconcilePlugins` (apps/cli/src/plugin.ts:59) is composition maintenance (bundle list) run only after a *successful* `pnpm install` — no backup/rollback, and it never touches `cordis.patch.yml` inserts.
- the loader (vendor/loader) hard-throws on any entry it can't import — no skip/isolate/quarantine.
- app-boot's `parsePatchList` merges user patches with no backup.

So one inconsistent registration strings the host to a hard crash with no recovery path in-kernel. That is exactly the case your release-gate proposal targets, and suggests a concrete kernel improvement alongside it:

**Proposed kernel guard:** at loader time, *isolate* a failing entry (log + quarantine suggestion, like the session-corruption handling, rather than hard-fail the whole boot) — and/or run a cheap pre-boot identity validation that a patch `insert.name` and any client registration id equal the installed package name, so a mismatch fails loudly but recoverably instead of bricking the host.

Also worth pinning in the #1719 contract as a convention: a plugin's identity-registering points (patch `insert.name`, client `__ModuleLoader__` id) must equal the npm package name.

Happy to expand the loader-isolate sketch into a patch draft for cherry-pick if the direction is welcome.

Follow-up from the design-partner reproduction: the published fix is verified.

`@moonquake2004/dsh-doctor@0.3.3` failed twice at boot under the exact pinned Docker/DSH environment because its patch used the bare loader specifier `dsh-doctor` while the npm package was scoped. The maintainer shipped `0.3.4` with the scoped loader name, and the same immutable npm artifact now passes both:

- the full `dsh-testkit@0.3.1` `quick` suite (resolve, install, assemble, boot, exercise, uninstall, reboot, cleanup)
- a dedicated `--case boot` run

Environment: DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`, Docker Linux arm64, Node `22.23.2`, pnpm `11.1.3`, runner image `dsh-testkit-runner:0.3.1-3b1e16f9759d`. Artifact digest: `sha256:e2e6ea8835e426bfbbb3dc09e2a9f54850f6eba2c7f05e3492ddf6191416edd0`.

This is a concrete example of why a release gate must exercise the published package in a disposable real host: source-level checks did not cover the scoped npm resolution path, while the lifecycle run caught it before adoption. The result is environment-bound evidence, not a certification claim.

The proposed loader isolation / pre-boot identity validation is a useful **separate DSH kernel hardening** direction. DSH Testkit can continue to detect and report these failures; it should not silently turn a failing host into a passing one. If the kernel team wants a focused reproduction or a patch draft, the issue thread and immutable artifact are available.

New design-partner evidence from `zoahdev/dsh-shelf@0.7.0`:

- Immutable Git commit: [`3787414`](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-shelf/commit/3787414102b160950a0859b77e9c0d59e7da0e6e)
- DSH Testkit `0.3.1`, DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`, Docker Linux arm64
- Full `quick` and dedicated boot runs both reproduced a pre-registration host boot failure
- Error: `cannot get property "baseDir" without inject`

The plugin read `ctx.baseDir`, but Cordis treats unknown context properties as injection lookups; DSH exposes `dshHomePath` instead. A local-only hypothesis patch using `ctx.dshHomePath?.()` passed the same boot run. I opened the maintainer issue with the exact artifact digest and reproduction: [zoahdev/dsh-shelf#1](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-shelf/issues/1).

This is a second concrete example of the proposed release gate: installation and bundle assembly passed, while the real host caught a published plugin compatibility defect before adoption. The report remains exact-artifact/host/scenario evidence, not a certification claim.

### New release-gate evidence: host preconditions matter

The `dsh-market` design partner reported a real Windows failure in `1.12.0`: Node was available, but `npm`/Corepack were not on `PATH`, so the artifact could not be installed. `1.12.2` fixes discovery beside `process.execPath`.

We verified `1.12.2` is published and recorded a release-gate refinement in [dsh-testkit#18](https://github.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit/issues/18): assert package-manager resolvability before plugin installation and classify missing toolchains as harness preconditions/infrastructure, not plugin failures. The live route gate will pin `1.12.2+`; `1.12.0` remains historical evidence.

### Web-host boundary from a design partner

A second partner confirmed that `dsh-status-rotator` is intentionally `dsh web`-only: its meaningful behavior is a browser DOM transition, while a headless boot has no client surface to test. We recorded an explicit web-profile fixture and deterministic browser smoke lane in [dsh-testkit#19](https://github.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit/issues/19), with `unsupported` when browser automation is unavailable.

This adds a concrete release-gate rule: do not collapse headless and Web host contracts into one pass/fail path.

### v0.3.2 release update / 发布更新

The vendor-neutral lifecycle boundary proposed here is now exercised by public DSH Testkit v0.3.2:

- exact packed artifact testing
- DSH 0.1.0-rc.7 default plus 0.1.0-rc.6 compatibility replay
- real-host install, boot, registration, deterministic exercise, uninstall, reboot, and residue checks
- machine-readable evidence and trusted npm publishing

Release: https://github.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit/tree/v0.3.2
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-testkit/v/0.3.2

The proposal remains intentionally vendor-neutral: this is a community reference implementation, not a request to make DSH Testkit an official dependency. The official Skill can adopt the lifecycle principles without naming a specific tool.

### v0.3.3 release evidence / v0.3.3 发布证据

The vendor-neutral lifecycle boundary is updated for the current DSH release train: Testkit `v0.3.3` defaults to DSH `0.1.1-rc.2` and retains exact replay targets for `0.1.0-rc.8`, `rc.7`, and `rc.6`.

Both `0.1.1-rc.2` and `0.1.0-rc.8` passed 8/8 lifecycle scenarios plus the native `dsh_test` bundle exercise. The project remains a community reference implementation and does not claim official DSH status.

- Release: https://github.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit/releases/tag/v0.3.3
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-testkit/v/0.3.3

Feature Request: 建立 Skill Hub 社区 + 预装常用 Skill

nodes.body:
This is the right gap to call out, and part of it already exists in community form — the distinction worth making is **plugin** vs **skill**, because DSH treats them differently.

For **plugins** (Cordis bundles, installed into a profile), there is already a community registry/marketplace: [dsh-subscribe](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-subscribe) — 569 plugins, searchable, with a one-command sync/install flow and a `verified` flag for the subset that has passing CI. It covers the "browse / search / one-command install" part of what you're describing.

What it does **not** cover yet, and where you're right that there's a real hole:

- **ratings / comments** — there's no review signal on a registry entry;
- **version management** — entries point at `latest`, not a resolved/verified version;
- **skills specifically** — the `~/.agents/skills/` surface is a different lifecycle than a Cordis plugin, and I don't think any community tool currently does browse/search/install for that directory.

If the official team wants a *community* skill hub rather than building one in-tree, the registry contract from dsh-subscribe is a reasonable thing to extend (a skills namespace + `dsh skill install <name>` resolver + a ratings field). I'd be glad to prototype that against the real skill directory semantics — the piece I'd need clarified from the team is whether skills are expected to be plain directory trees (trivial to distribute) or have their own manifest/version contract (needs a spec).

这个需求可以拆成两个阶段：先让可审计的 Skill bundle 可安装，再做跨作者的 Hub。现在已经有一个可运行的前一阶段实现，可用于验证 DSH 的真实安装/发现边界，而不必等完整 Marketplace。

[SandBase Skills](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-skills) 把 88 个 Skills 暴露为原生 DSH plugin bundle，其中 `multi-source-search` 不需要 SandBase 账号，直接使用宿主已有的搜索/页面读取工具。项目根目录可执行：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sandbaseai/sandbase-skills
dsh web
```

如果只想安装一个 Skill，而不是整个 profile bundle：

```bash
npx --yes github:sandbaseai/sandbase-skills add multi-source-search
```

安装器会复制完整目录树到项目级 `.dsh/skills/<skill-name>`，不会只复制 `SKILL.md` 而丢失脚本、references 或 assets。仓库内的 manifest、目录发现、覆盖保护、路径名校验和 Skill catalog 都有自动测试。这不是一个带评分/评论的 Hub，但能作为 Hub resolver 的兼容样本。

我建议官方 Hub 的最小验收边界至少包括：

1. **不可变解析**：展示版本与实际下载的 commit/tag/digest 一致，不能把 `latest` 当成已验证版本。
2. **来源与许可证**：保留 repo、commit、license 和发布者关联，UI 能追溯到原始文件。
3. **完整目录校验**：验证 frontmatter、相对引用、脚本/assets 存在性，而不是只检查单个 Markdown。
4. **分层与冲突规则**：明确 built-in、用户级和项目级 Skill 的优先级；同名不能静默覆盖。
5. **隔离、回滚与健康状态**：新版本先进入可检查状态，失败时保留上一个可用版本。
6. **能力声明**：区分只使用宿主工具的 Skill 与需要 MCP、密钥、网络或本地可执行文件的 Skill。

这样可以先预装一小组纯宿主能力、无账号依赖的 Skills，再让需要外部权限的条目走显式安装与授权，避免“预装即隐式授予能力”。

关联披露：我参与 SandBase 项目；上面的仓库是一个开源 Apache-2.0 参考实现，不代表 DeepSeek 官方 Skill Hub 路线图。

I really need this feature and would love to see official support for it. I also have some related requirements and implementation ideas that I’d be happy to share for reference: https://github.com/saitamahang/dsh-skill-importer.git

discussions.title: 💻插件库应该由官方来做才安全

nodes.body:
You're right that the raw numbers are exploding and that "near-duplicate + potentially malicious" is the real risk. The practical answer is not necessarily official centralization (the team hasn't opened the PR channel, and a full official review org is heavy), but a **layered, verifiable trust model** — and most of the layers already exist in community form:

1. **Registry with a `verified` flag** — [dsh-subscribe](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-subscribe) is a 569-plugin registry, but only a small subset carries `verified`, and it requires actual passing CI (build/test/install) rather than self-attestation. Curation at the registry layer is the cheap first filter.
2. **Static, deterministic audit** — [dsh-sandbox-audit](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-sandbox-audit) checks whether a profile's *sandbox wiring* actually enforces the policy it claims (bare `fs-local`, unguarded reads, destructive ops). It runs on config, is reproducible, and gates CI — it catches the "says read-only but can write" class of problem without any LLM.
3. **LLM source review** — [dsh-code-security](https://github.com/ihuajiu/dsh-code-security) (by ihuajiu, from #2198) reads plugin *source code* with bounded collection + secret redaction + untrusted-input framing, which is the layer that can actually flag malicious code/prompts.

The honest caveat: none of these alone is a silver bullet, and "AI review" has a false-negative problem — a policy inconsistency that a static check catches instantly is exactly the kind of thing an LLM reviewer will often miss, and vice versa. That's why the useful model is **gate = registry-verified AND static-audit-clean AND (optionally) LLM-reviewed**, not "official team approves every plugin".

If the maintainers want to define a single canonical `verified` contract (what a plugin must pass to be trusted-by-default), I'd be glad to write that spec against the existing dsh-subscribe / dsh-sandbox-audit / dsh-code-security behavior so the three tools converge on one definition instead of three slightly-different ones.

插件库安全担忧很真实——上千个插件、近三分之一功能近似、可能埋恶意代码，官方审核或 AI 审核确实该上。

这和我们第 13 章的判断一致：安全工具链（vetting/check-dsh-profile/Plugin Doctor/Codex 门禁）先顶上，官方 registry + 审核是治本。https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook/blob/main/docs/13-security.md

Same bug confirmed here on the shipped bundle (dsh 0.1.0-rc.7, web profile). I applied a stronger local fix than the substring approach and want to share it, since it makes the skill menu behave exactly like the command menu:

**Fix (verified locally):** port the command menu's existing matcher (`fuzzyScore` + `fuzzyCandidates` in `packages/client/ui-commands`, lib `client.js` ~L444-488) into `packages/client/ui-skill`'s `candidates()`:

Verified against the shipped `dsh-client-ui-skill` bundle: typing `/debug` now surfaces `systematic-debugging`, which the old `startsWith` filter never returned.

One suggestion for the maintainers: instead of duplicating the matcher, extract `fuzzyScore`/`fuzzyCandidates` into a shared client utility (e.g. `packages/client/ui-primitives`) so all three sources — command (`/`), skill (`/`), subagent (`@`) — use one matcher. `ui-subagent` currently uses a plain `includes`, so it would benefit too.

Landed a fix for the exact mechanism you traced:

userQuestions: single global provider without timeout hangs non-web channels (WeChat/Telegram gateways) forever

nodes.body:
Verified every claim against master (47f943859b) — your analysis is accurate, and this is the interaction-seam sibling of an unbounded-wait family I've been tracking (#1607, `cordis_inspect_query`). Adding the source-level layer:

**1. All three claims confirm at source.** The provider registers unconditionally (`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:1369` — always in `apply()`, no browser-presence gate), `registerProvider` rejects a second with `DUPLICATE_PROVIDER` (`packages/interaction/user-questions/src/index.ts:64-73`), and `ask()` settles on exactly three paths: mux answer, abort signal (`ASK_ABORTED`), or provider disposal — none of which fire when no browser is connected, because the `for (const queue of muxQueues)` fan-out at `api-proxy.ts:1394` iterates an empty set (`muxQueues` fills only when a client opens `events.mux`, `:3432`). Confirmed: hang until turn-cancel, exactly as you describe.

**2. Precision on the approval contrast — it's fail-closed fallthrough, not a timeout.** The approval seam doesn't have a "default-deny timeout" either; it has an **answerer chain with a fail-closed default**: when no handler claims the request the chain calls `next()` and the ask settles `'unavailable'` (`packages/interaction/user-approval/src/index.ts:25/:53/:89` — "failure yields the fail-closed default"). The userQuestions provider has no chain — it IS the single sink, so there's no fallthrough to settle the promise. That's the structural gap: approval is a dispatch with a default; userQuestions is a sink with no default. Any fix should add the missing "no answerer → settle" arm rather than a blanket timeout, because...

**3. The key design point: distinguish "no listener" from "listener hasn't answered".** A hard `timeoutMs` on `ask_user_question` would punish slow human readers (the tool registers no `timeoutMs` today, so the cooperative guard at `packages/guard/timeout-policy/src/index.ts:57-59` can't rescue it either). But offline detection is trivially and safely implementable: `muxQueues.size === 0` at ask time → reject synchronously with a distinct code (`ASK_NO_CLIENT`-style) so the model can fall back to plain-text asking. The race window (client connecting between ask and reject) is handled by the mux replay at `api-proxy.ts:3438-3443` — pending questions are re-pushed to a newly-connecting client — so a short grace period (e.g. 2–5 s before the no-client rejection) preserves connect-race semantics for free.

**4. Your suggestion 3 (question event) matches the in-repo precedent exactly.** `approval/request` already establishes the forward→reply→resolve pattern with the `approval/asked`+`approval/decided` audit pair; a `question/requested` event on the service (not just the mux frame) would let gateways forward without shadowing. And suggestion 2 (per-agent routing) fits the existing `ask(request)` signature — it already receives `request.agent?.id` (used for the sessionId requirement at `api-proxy.ts:1373-1378`) — so a provider-selection layer on `agent` is a natural extension, not a new concept.

**5. Family note.** This is the second confirmed instance of the "promise that never settles while the listener is absent" class: #1607 (`cordis_inspect_query`, same empty-fanout shape, same manual-cancel rescue, same cooperative-timeout gap — `packages/extensions/tool-cordis/src/index.ts:61-90` registers no `timeoutMs`). Both are fixed by the same two-layer recipe: **fail-fast when zero listeners + optional generous `timeoutMs` as safety net**. If the maintainers want a single small PR, the no-listener check at ask time is ~5 lines in `api-proxy.ts` plus a distinct error code in `user-questions` — and it would close both reports' core gap.

Your scoped-shadowing workaround is a nice illustration that the architecture is right even where the capability is missing — worth keeping in the thread as the community reference implementation.

discussions.title: 怎么配置MCP服务器给harness用？

nodes.body:
MCP 在 DSH 里没有独立的 `mcp.json`，一个服务器就是 profile patch 里的一行插件配置，用官方的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`。下面的字段是按 `packages/mcp/mcp-client/src/index.ts` 的 schema 写的，我在 rc.7 上实际跑通过。

编辑 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`（想只对某个项目生效就用项目里的 `.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-github
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: 'github'
        transport: stdio
        command: 'npx'
        args: ['-y', '@modelcontextprotocol/server-github']
```

远程服务器换成 http 那一支：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-remote
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: 'remote'
        transport: streamable-http
        url: 'https://mcp.example.com'
        headers:
          Authorization: !!js process.env.MY_TOKEN
```

几个容易踩的点

- `transport` 只有 `stdio` 和 `streamable-http` 两种。stdio 支路的字段是 `command` / `args` / `env` / `cwd`，http 支路是 `url` / `headers`，两边混写会 schema 报错。
- `serverName` 必须全局唯一，重名会直接报 `serverName "x" is already in use by another mcp-client instance`。`id` 也要唯一，重复的 loader id 会让 `dsh web` 启动失败而不是跳过。
- 密钥不要写死在 YAML 里，用 `!!js process.env.XXX` 引用环境变量。
- 每个服务器一行 `insert`，配好后重启 `dsh web`，用 `dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep mcp-` 确认行确实合成进去了。
- 工具名和 Claude Code 那边完全一致，都是 `mcp__<server>__<tool>`，所以原来写的提示词和权限规则里的工具名不用改。

补充一点，如果 patch 里写了 profile 解析不到的包，DSH 是启动直接失败而不是警告，所以先确认 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 已经装进 profile 再写这些行。

利益相关，我在做一个把 Claude Code 配置搬进 DSH 的工具，上面这些行就是它自动生成的，`.mcp.json` 里的服务器会原样转成这个格式：https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-movein 。不想装工具的话照着上面手写完全一样。

需要装，而且这里有个坑，我刚在干净环境里实测了两遍。

**直接装会拿到一个很老的版本。**

```
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client
```

装出来是 `0.0.1-rc.1`，因为这个包的 npm dist-tag 还停在旧版：

```
{ latest: '0.0.1-rc.1', next: '0.1.0-rc.7' }
```

**所以要跟宿主 dsh 版本对齐着装。** 先看自己的版本，再按这个版本号 pin：

```
dsh --version                                              # 比如 0.1.0-rc.7
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.1.0-rc.7
```

这样装出来就是 0.1.0-rc.7，我这边验证过。

**另外会看到一条 warning，那是正常的，不用管：**

```
dsh: warning: @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client declares no dsh.bundle
  — installed as a plain dependency, not a profile layer
```

因为 mcp-client 本身不是 bundle，它不会自己往 profile 里插行。激活方式就是你手动在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里写那条 `insert`（也就是上一条回复里的 YAML），一个服务器一行。装包 + 写行，两步都做完再重启 `dsh web` 就能用了。

顺序建议是先装包再写行。反过来的话，profile 里解析不到这个包时 `dsh web` 会直接启动失败而不是警告，那时候连 UI 都进不去，只能手动去改 YAML。

discussions.title: Agent 反问一次，任务就卡死 10 分钟：你们怎么处理「ask_user_question」的？

nodes.body:
你的定位是对的：`question/requested` 是独立于 `approval/requested` 的可应答帧，不能只转发审批流。当前 API 的 mux 在重连时会重放仍未回答的问题，并复用原来的 `rpcId`，因此中继最好把问题当作一等的持久交互，而不是普通通知。

建议的处理模型：

1. 以 `(rpcId, sessionId)` 作为幂等键持久化待回答问题；手机真正渲染成功后再确认本地投递。
2. 回答时外层 `client-response` 必须原样回显该 `rpcId`，内层再发送你列出的 `{sessionId, answer:{answers:[...]}}`。只按 `sessionId` 回答会在重连或并发问题时串单。
3. 当前 Session 标记为 `waiting_user`，但释放全局 worker，让其他 Session/任务继续；同一 Session 不应在问题未解决时启动下一轮。
4. 每个 Session 最多保留一个活动问题。重连时按 `rpcId` 去重；Web 与手机同时回答时，以服务端首个 accepted 响应为准，另一端收到 resolved 后关闭卡片。
5. 超时策略按风险分级：不可逆操作、安全选择和需求歧义不得自动猜答案，超时应取消；只有明确配置了安全默认值的低风险问题才允许自动继续。
6. Agent 侧限制“何时问”：当前 standard preset 已要求只对用户拥有的选择或无法通过检查消除的重大歧义调用 `ask_user_question`，可以再增加每轮/每任务上限。

相关协议在 [`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/events.ts`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/events.ts)；其中重连重放和 `rpcId` 语义已经写入契约。

discussions.title: 手机远程控制电脑上的 Agent：你们觉得最该防的安全坑是什么？

nodes.body:
如果不走 Tailscale、而是直接把 Bearer Token 放在明文 HTTP 上，令牌会被同链路上的观察者读取并重放，不能认为安全。Tailscale 数据面本身使用 WireGuard 端到端加密，但仍应配 ACL，只允许指定手机访问指定端口；公网方案则必须是 HTTPS/WSS，不能只靠“强令牌”。

我认为最容易漏掉的是**组合权限导致的数据外泄**：单独“读文件”和“发网络请求”看似低风险，组合后就能把 SSH Key、浏览器 Cookie、`.env` 等带走。因此建议 checklist 至少包括：

1. 每台手机独立身份：一次性配对 + 设备公钥，短期访问令牌，支持单设备吊销和轮换；令牌不要放 URL、日志或浏览器 `localStorage`。
2. 状态修改请求加入短时效、nonce/请求 ID 和幂等检查，防止截获后的重放。
3. 审批必须绑定**不可变的实际动作**：完整命令、cwd、环境变量、文件路径/差异、网络目标；审批后任何参数变化都使审批失效，且批准只能使用一次。
4. Agent 使用低权限 OS 账号、工作区白名单和出站网络白名单；读取密钥目录、凭据存储、浏览器资料应直接列为高风险，而不是普通 read。
5. 手机端启用生物识别/PIN、空闲锁定；服务端具备总开关、会话 TTL、速率限制、连续失败锁定和设备远程吊销。
6. 保留不可由 Agent 修改的审计日志，记录“谁、何时、批准了哪个精确动作”，并允许一键终止进程树。
7. 外部网页、Issue、日志等都按不可信输入处理；审批卡展示真实参数，不能只展示模型写的自然语言理由。

一句话劝退：**没有端到端加密、可撤销的设备身份和受限执行账号时，不要远程开放能执行命令的 Agent。**

参考：[Tailscale 的端到端加密与 ACL 说明](https://tailscale.com/security)。
