discussions.title: Overthingking on any model
[BUG] Spawned subagents inherit the parent's creation-time model options — stale provider keeps 401ing until server restart

nodes.body:
Verified against the current checkout (master @ `99f6f02fec`, rc.7) — every claim in the report checks out, and the precise mechanism boundary is even narrower than "children copy frozen options".

**1. Confirmed at source.**
- `resolveChildAgentOptions` (`packages/subagent/subagent/src/child-agent.ts:68-83`) copies `parent.options.provider/model/maxTokens` and only then spreads the per-child `requested` override (so the per-tool escape hatch really does win — your workaround #2 is correct).
- Single composition home: the module doc states "Both the one-shot provider driver and the continuation manager compose children this way" — `continuation.ts:444` is the one call site. One fix covers `subagent` AND `subagent_fork`.
- Parent-side liveness: `selectionFor(agent)` (`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:1123-1150`) computes the per-request waterfall exactly as you described (picked → `agent.session.requestHeader()?.config` → `defaults.defaultModelSelection()`), and `installModelSelection(agent.ctx, selection)` (`packages/core/agent/src/model-selection.ts:39-78`) couples it to request routing.

**2. The mechanism boundary — why the parent switches but the child never does.**
The `selections` map is keyed **by Agent instance** (api-proxy.ts:1123), and the selection handlers are registered on the *parent's* scoped ctx. The child is composed on its own scoped ctx via `this.ownerCtx.agents.create(...)` (continuation.ts:1016) — it never enters the parent's `selections` map, and nothing in the child's own scope chain rewrites its route. Then the seed timing locks it in: `buildRequest` seeds the first `request/header` from `this.options` when `!requestHeaderLogged` (`agent.ts:428-437`, header logged at :465-470). So the entire divergence is decided **at seed time** — after its first request the child would re-resolve like any agent, but by then its header already carries the stale route. This also explains why your restart workaround works: cold resume re-creates the session agent with the live default, so the next child seeds correctly.

**3. Fix design — three tiers.**
- **Minimal (package-local, has a precedent in the same file)**: in `resolveChildAgentOptions`, prefer the parent's *live* route — `parent.session.requestHeader()?.config` (provider/model/maxTokens) — over `parent.options`. `requestHeader()` is a public Session API (`session/index.ts:670`) returning the folded latest `request/header`, and after a mid-session switch it already carries the new provider (your evidence: parent header seq ~26 = `opencode-go`). The precedent is literally next door: `childSessionMeta` (`child-agent.ts:107`) already reads `parent.session.header` for the same reason — persist/seed what the child will actually run under, not what the parent started with. This alone fixes your exact scenario.
- **Edge case**: a child spawned *immediately after* the switch, before the parent's next request, still sees the stale folded header (the header only advances when the parent actually makes a request). Full correctness needs the fallback chain to the live default — but the subagent package can't reach `ctx.agentDefaultModel` (host service, api-proxy/index.ts:99). That tier needs either a small injected resolver (an optional `resolveDefaultModel` callback threaded into the subagent service config, defaulting to `parent.options`) or moving the decision from creation time to the child's first `agent/request` waterfall.
- **Symmetric long-term**: `selectionFor.current`'s `picked` tier (per-session `/model` switch) also only reaches the child after the parent has made one request under it. If in-process children shared the parent's `WebModelSelectionRef` instead of re-deriving, `/model` switches would propagate to children too — the cleanest end-state, at the cost of crossing the api-proxy/subagent boundary.

**4. Family + regression test.**
This is the "creation-time snapshot diverges from live state" pattern — same root shape as the replay-state coherence family (#1627/#1703/#2143: durable content vs frozen replay metadata): a value captured at creation outlives the state it was derived from, and only a cold re-create resyncs. The asymmetry that hid it: the parent's own path was already fixed to be live (per-request re-resolution), but the child-composition path kept the frozen snapshot. A regression test would be cheap: spawn a child after a mid-session model switch, assert the child's first `request/header` carries the new route.

One question this raises that the report doesn't cover: **continuable children on cold resume** — a child resumed from disk re-creates from its persisted header (the stale one). Does the resume path re-resolve the route the same way `selectionFor` does for parents, or does it keep the stale route until its first request? If the latter, the minimal fix should also cover the resume path, not just the spawn path.

Implemented and regression-tested a package-local fix for the stale child route described here.

Patch commit: https://github.com/jzhao0/deepseek-harness/commit/bead7b4f88c0f0d8313667d24857a933012285b4
Branch: https://github.com/jzhao0/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/subagent-live-route-inheritance

The change makes `resolveChildAgentOptions()` prefer the parent's latest `session.requestHeader()?.config` for `provider`, `model`, and `maxTokens`, with per-field fallback to `parent.options`; explicit child `agentOptions` still win. Continuable creation resolves the route once before its first await and reuses that snapshot for both the durable descriptor and materialization.

Regression coverage: one-shot and continuable RED→GREEN, relevant inheritance suites 14/14, and the assembled keyless snapshot fails against the old source and passes with the patch.

I also tried to open an upstream PR, but the repository currently reports `has_pull_requests=false` and GitHub rejects `CreatePullRequest`. The commit above is ready to cherry-pick; if PRs are re-enabled I can open it immediately.

discussions.title: 插件能力声明（capability declaration）：让 Agent 自组装按“能力”寻址，而非猜插件名

nodes.body:
顺带同步：能力声明（capability declaration）想法的第一个可运行实现已经落地 👉 **#2907**（dsh-plugin-dynamic-assembler 0.2.0）：自然语言驱动、官方优先、非官方插件过静态安全审计后才加载。

本帖继续聊“能力声明机制”本身的取舍；具体实现与踩坑去 #2907 拍砖更合适。欢迎两边都来。
skill的机制吗？

@xmanrui 好问题，正好把这层关系厘清。

**skill 是执行层，能力声明是寻址层。** 现在用 dsh 插件，agent 得先知道「有个插件叫 xxx、能干嘛」——本质在**猜插件名**。能力声明反过来：每个插件在 manifest 里声明自己「能做什么」（读文件 / 发 HTTP / 生成图…），agent 按**需求**去匹配能力，由运行时把「能力」翻译成「具体哪个插件 / 工具」，而不是写死调用名。

打个比方：skill 机制是「我雇了个厨师老王」（按名字寻址）；能力声明是「我需要会做川菜的人」，运行时自动找到老王（或任何会做川菜的人），老王换了也不影响调用方。

为啥这层值得单独做：

- **解耦**：编排写「要什么能力」，不写「调哪个插件」，换实现 / 换作者不影响上层
- **可组合**：agent 能按能力自拼工具链（自组装），正是 dsh 的下半场
- **可审计**：能力声明 + 静态安全审查（我的 `assemble_inspect`）让「自组装 + 第三方插件」既可行又安全

可运行实现在 👉 #2907（dsh-plugin-dynamic-assembler 0.2.0），已跑通「按能力匹配、官方优先、非官方过安全审查才加载」。

所以不是「skill 的机制」，而是 skill 之上补一层**能力寻址 + 编排**——理解为「skill 的路由 / 调度层」也 OK。机制取舍欢迎来 #2907 接着聊。

discussions.title: Should edit guidance explicitly prohibit parallel edits to the same file?
主session调用上千subagent，严重拖慢dsh速度
[Ideas] edit 工具是否应该明确提示：同一文件的多个编辑不能并行执行？

nodes.body:
个人认为靠提示词去约束模型效果还是不太稳定，这个应该属于工具层，由它们自己去决定是否支持串行还是并行，如果 edit 自身支持同个文件多个 edit，那这个其实就不是问题了，甚至可以减少调用的 round

可以看下我这个[dsh-better-edit](https://github.com/Rianico/dsh-better-edit)，基于 hashline 设计，对于并发跟多次修改，我是这样设计的：
1. 设计成单个文件允许多个 chained edit（单 edit 多个 patch），一次调用就可以进行多轮修改，这样一来其实就没理由并发地去调用 edit 去操作同个文件
2. 如果模型依旧并发去 edit 同个文件，那应该是工具的职责去保障正确性，我的工具内部做了正确性校验，哪个 edit 成功了其他 edit 就会被拒绝并返回错误码跟理由
3. 多个 edit 操作同个文件肯定是不好的设计，这样就造成了竞态条件，我觉得 claude 的 subagent + git worktree 组合已经给出了答案

[Bug] 版本 token 包含 ctime 导致元数据未变、内容未变时误报 FS_STALE_VERSION

nodes.body:
在当前 master 上核对了一下，versionOf 的实现和你贴的完全一致，dev:ino:size:mtimeNs:ctimeNs，在 packages/fs/fs-local/src/fsio.ts 第 74 到 75 行。

关于你问的第一个问题，ctimeNs 是不是故意加进去防止漏报的安全选择，我查了一下 git 历史。这行是在提交 a0e917ffe3（"Optimize workspace instruction change detection"）里加进去的，提交信息和代码注释（"high-resolution identity and freshness metadata"）都没提到安全方面的考虑。看起来更像是那次提交为了另一个功能（workspace-context 的变更检测）改用 bigint stats，顺带复用了这个共享 helper，把 ctime 也带了进来，不太像是专门为了防止伪造 mtime 才加的。所以我的判断是这更偏向"还没考虑到"而不是"刻意的安全取舍"，不过最终还是要维护者来确认。

不过在去掉 ctime 之前，有一点我觉得值得摆出来。mtime 是任何有写权限的进程都能任意设置的，标准的 utime 系统调用不需要特殊权限就能把 mtime 改成任意值。ctime 不一样，POSIX 下没有办法直接设置 ctime，内核只要检测到元数据或内容变化就会自动更新它。所以现在这个版本 token 对"先改内容再把 mtime 改回原值"这种攻击是有一定抵抗力的，只用 mtime 就没有这层保护了。这是一个比较窄的威胁模型，日常场景下大概率没人会关心，但这是一个真实存在的差异，不只是文中说的 small risk 那么简单，值得维护者明确权衡一下再决定，而不是当作纯粹的收益来采纳。

另外 README 里已有的 Known Limitations 那条其实说的是反方向的问题，存储层没法更新 mtime/ctime 导致漏报，并不覆盖你这里说的元数据变了但内容没变这种误报场景。如果方案 1 或方案 2 落地，这确实算是一个新场景，值得单独补一条说明。

对照当前 main HEAD `99f6f02` 复核：`packages/fs/fs-local/src/fsio.ts:74-75` 的 `versionOf` 与两位贴的完全一致（dev:ino:size:mtimeNs:ctimeNs），复现前提成立。

把决策框架再压缩一下——这其实是一个 2×2 权衡，不是纯收益比较：

| | 保留 ctime 硬校验 | 去掉 ctime |
|---|---|---|
| **只修误报（content 兜底）** | 方案 2（edit 内容兜底 + write 保持 stat-only）——**同时保留防 mtime 伪造** | 方案 1（零成本）——失去防伪造 |
| **不修误报** | 现状 | — |

Mide69 的 git 历史调查（a0e917ffe3 是为 workspace-context 变更检测改 bigint stats、顺带复用共享 helper）很有说服力——ctime 大概率不是刻意的安全取舍，但**防伪造属性是真实存在的**（无论初衷如何）。所以我的建议按维护者对威胁模型的回答分叉：

1. **若认为"先改内容再伪造 mtime"在威胁模型内**（比如沙箱外的文件由不可信进程写入的场景）：选**方案 2 限定 edit + 保留 ctime**——chmod/chown 误报被内容兜底消掉，伪造 mtime 仍被 ctime 抓住，两个性质兼得；write 保持 stat-only 快路径（残余 ctime 误报可接受）。
2. **若认为该威胁模型不在范围内**（大多数本地单用户场景）：方案 1 就是正确选择，零成本、与 Git/rsync/make 的惯例一致。

**方案 2 的一个实现要点**（帖里已点到，值得说透）：内容快照必须来自**上一次 readText 的观察状态**，而不是 editText 内部——editText 是在编辑时整读文件，此时 stat 已经不一致，读到的内容正是"当前内容"，无法判断"编辑前内容是否等于 read 时的内容"。所以方案 2 需要 fs-observation-policy 扩展存储"读过的文件内容哈希"，成本如帖主所说限于 readText 路径。

**回归测试建议**（三种行为一次钉住）：

1. chmod-only（ctime 变、mtime/content 不变）→ edit 成功（方案 1/2 都过）；
2. 内容改了 + `utimes` 把 mtime 改回原值 → 保留 ctime 时**仍必须 FS_STALE_VERSION**（证明防伪造没被方案 2 削弱）；
3. writeText 路径不读内容（stat-only 性能特征）——用测试或文档钉住，防止未来给 write 叠加内容读取。

无论选哪条，README 的 Known Limitations 都值得补一句"版本 token 对纯元数据变化（chmod/chown/xattr）敏感，chmod-only 会导致 read→edit 误报 FS_STALE_VERSION"，把行为写清楚，模型提示里也能引用。

discussions.title: feat(dsh-settings): let plugins declare their settings namespace as web-exposable, removing the apiproxy allowlist as the only opt-in path
Issue: Model never calls a dynamically registered tool even though its schema is present in every subsequent request
减少token消耗计划：unicode61 tokenizer 无法检索中文（连整句都搜不到）——附社区修复插件

nodes.body:
*English summary: source-verified at rc.7 (99f6f02fec) + empirically reproduced with node:sqlite (the same engine the package uses). Confirmed: FTS5 `tokenize='unicode61'` on both tables (schema.ts:135/166), and the caller query is ALWAYS wrapped as one quoted phrase (`quoteFtsData`, query.ts:223-225, used at index.ts:840) — so a Chinese substring query can only match if the document contains the exact same Han run. Trigram dual-table + CJK routing is the right shape and empirically fixes the substring case (verified "Token消耗" and "索引优化" → hits). CRITICAL trap: trigram cannot match 1-2 char queries ("消耗"/"索引" → 0 hits) — the routing layer must fall back to LIKE (trigram enables the LIKE optimization, verified) or unicode61 exact-match. Integration details for upstream: new FTS5 table must be added to DERIVED_USER_TABLES (schema.ts:16-25) or existing DBs fail assertDerivedUserTables ("unrecognized user tables"), plus SESSION_QUERY_SQLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION 8→9 reset (schema.ts:66); the routing branch can follow the existing persisted+live UNION ALL pattern (index.ts:795-835); watch trigram's case_sensitive option (default off = matches unicode61's case folding; on changes English behavior).*

源码验证（rc.7 `99f6f02fec`）+ 实测复现（node:sqlite，与包内同一引擎）——你的观察完全正确，且有一个社区插件方案可能踩到的坑值得补上。

## 1. 机制确认（源码）

- `packages/session-query/session-query-sqlite/src/schema.ts:135` 与 `:166` —— `persisted_docs` 和 `temp.live_docs` 两个 FTS5 表都用 `tokenize = 'unicode61'`。
- `src/query.ts:223-225` `quoteFtsData()` —— 调用方查询被**整体包成单个短语**（`"..."`，双引号转义），`src/index.ts:840` 同时用于两个 MATCH 谓词（:804 / :827）。
- unicode61 对连续汉字**不切词**：整段汉字 = 一个 token。短语查询只能命中与文档 token 完全一致的汉字串 → 你的两个 0 命中用例在机制上必然如此。

## 2. 实测数据（node:sqlite，FTS5，同一引擎）

文档 `索引优化减少Token消耗的句子`：

| 查询 | unicode61（上游现状） | trigram（社区方案） |
|------|----------------------|--------------------|
| `"Token消耗"` | **0** | ✅ 1 |
| `"索引优化"` | **0** | ✅ 1 |
| 完整整句 | 1（唯一命中方式） | 1 |
| `"消耗"`（2 字） | 0 | **0 ⚠️** |
| `"索引"`（2 字） | 0 | **0 ⚠️** |
| `"优"`（1 字） | 0 | **0 ⚠️** |
| `LIKE '%消耗%'` | 1（线性扫描） | 1（**trigram 启用 LIKE 优化**） |

结论：**双表 + CJK 路由的方向正确**，trigram 实测修复了子串召回（含中英混合 "Token消耗"，trigram 对 ASCII 子串同样建索引）。

## 3. 关键坑：1-2 字中文查询在 trigram 下必然 0 命中

trigram tokenizer 只索引 ≥3 字符的连续子串——**"消耗"、"索引"这类二字查询（中文查询的常见形态）在 trigram 表上直接 0 命中**，除非你额外处理。三种可行回退：

1. **LIKE 回退**（推荐）：路由层对 CJK 查询若 <3 字符 → `text LIKE '%词%'`。实测 trigram 表上 LIKE 命中且走索引优化（trigram 是唯一支持 LIKE 优化的 FTS5 tokenizer）；1-2 字中文是高频查询，这个回退是刚需。
2. unicode61 表精确匹配回退（只对整段一致时命中，与现状相同）。
3. 对 2 字词做 bigram 索引（更复杂，不推荐作为 v1）。

**注意路由顺序**：`contains CJK` 判定不能只看"是否含 CJK"，还要看 CJK 子串长度——混合查询 "Token消耗" 的 CJK 部分是 2 字，但整体 ≥3 字符（"ke消" 是合法 trigram），实测 trigram 表直接命中；纯 2 字查询才需要 LIKE 回退。建议路由逻辑：`CJK 子串长度 < 3 且查询总长 < 3 → LIKE 回退`，否则走 trigram 表。

## 4. 若合并上游：三个集成细节（社区插件不需要，但上游合并必须）

1. **DERIVED_USER_TABLES 白名单**（schema.ts:16-25）：新增的 FTS5 表名必须加进这个集合，否则已有数据库在下一次打开时被 `assertDerivedUserTables`（:87-94）判为 "unrecognized user tables" 直接拒开——这是派生索引的自保护，也意味着新表名要同步。
2. **SCHEMA_VERSION 8 → 9**（schema.ts:8、:66）：加表/换 tokenizer 是不兼容变更，`openSearchDatabase` 会就地 reset 重建（:96-101），老库自动迁移。
3. **查询分支可复用现有 persisted+live 的 UNION ALL 模式**（index.ts:795-835）：第三个分支（或按查询路由替换 MATCH 表达式）加 trigram 表即可；`highlight()`/`match_count`/snippet 路径（:800-833）对 trigram 表同样工作，无额外改动。

另外提醒：trigram 的 `case_sensitive` 选项默认关闭（与 unicode61 的大小写折叠一致）；若设成 1，英文大小写行为会变——保持默认即可不回归英文/代码检索。

## 5. 回答你的问题

- 官方计划：无从知晓（本仓库 issues/PRs 通道仍禁用），但从源码看这个缺口是真实的（unicode61 对 CJK 无切词 + 单短语查询 = 中文子串召回必然失败），且修复面**相当收敛**（一张 trigram 表 + 路由 + 版本号 + 白名单，~50 行内），是社区最值得催的接口补全之一。
- 社区方案能否合并：**方向可行**，合并前补上 1-2 字回退（LIKE）+ 上述三个集成点即可。你的 fork（双表 + 路由）与上游现有 UNION ALL 结构天然兼容。
- 若你想让方案更有说服力：建议在 README 里加一张和上面类似的对照表（unicode61 vs trigram 对 1/2/3+ 字查询），并注明 LIKE 回退——这正好把"能搜到"的边界讲清楚。

复现脚本（node:sqlite，可直接跑）：`CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE t USING fts5(text, tokenize='trigram')` 后 `SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE t MATCH '"消耗"'` 即得 0；`LIKE '%消耗%'` 即得 1。

discussions.title: 【BUG】harness死循环

nodes.body:
先确认一个代码层面的现状（对照 main/master HEAD `99f6f02` rc.7），这直接决定你的止损方式：

**agent-loop 没有内置"步数上限 / token 预算 / 成本熔断"。** `packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts` 只有 `maxParallelToolCalls`（默认 10，控制单轮并行工具数），没有 max-steps、没有累计 token 上限、没有成本熔断器。也就是说：只要模型持续请求工具调用，循环就会一直跑——`dsh-budget`（#2553）这类成本治理插件是**唯一现成的熔断手段**。

**建议先分三类定位你的日志（决定是不是同一种病）：**

1. **工具调用循环**（模型自己反复 search / 检索 → 再 search）：日志里会出现连续多个 `tool/call`（search 类）且每个 turn 都产生新工具请求。这属于 #3171 族，argszero 在 [#2821](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2821) 有完整诊断（模型陷入"查一下再查一下"的确认循环）。你贴的这句 "Let me do one or two final searches... and then write the answer" 反复出现，很像这一类。
2. **重试风暴**：如果循环里穿插 `EMPTY_RESPONSE`/`TRANSPORT` 等可重试失败（retry-policy.ts:19-25 默认可重试码），那是 #199 族机制（我们在 #199 核验过完整链路）。
3. **单轮超长**：搜索结果巨大撑爆 context，单轮就烧掉大量 token（这是另一类，需要 `dsh-budget` 或超时策略）。

**立即可用的止损：**
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-budget   # 成本上限 + 超限策略（#2553 社区插件）
```
另建议给 profile 配 per-tool timeout（`timeout-policy` guard）并限制 search 类工具的并行/次数。

**为了让官方/社区能定位，请补：** ① dsh 版本；② session log 里 `tool/call` 的 turn 序列（几次、什么工具、有没有 error/finish 重试）；③ 会话开始时间与 token 消耗曲线。有了这三样，就能判定是循环失控还是重试风暴，也才能对症优化。

**给官方的建议（本次事故的核心诉求）：** 在 agent-loop 增加**可选的累计步数/成本熔断**（默认关闭或低默认值，与 dsh-budget 语义协作），避免"跑一夜烧光预算"这类无断路器事故。这值得单独开一个 feature 提案帖。

应 #3228/#3229 两帖（两位都烧光余额/预算）整理一份 feature 提案草稿，供合并立项：

**提案：agent-loop 内置可选的累计步数/成本熔断（circuit breaker）**

**动机**：agent-loop 目前只有 `maxParallelToolCalls`（默认 10），没有累计步数、累计 token 或成本上限（代码现状已核验：packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts）。模型陷入"查一下再查一下"的确认循环时，循环会一直跑，直到余额烧光——#3228（1 亿+ token）、#3229（小问答耗尽余额）都是同一事故类。

**设计（最小闭环）**：
1. **可选配置**（默认关闭，避免行为变化）：
   ```yaml
   agent-loop:
     circuitBreaker:
       maxStepsPerTurn: 50          # 单 turn 累计工具步数上限
       maxTokensPerSession: 0       # 0 = 不限制；>0 = 会话累计 token 上限
       maxCostCents: 0              # 0 = 不限制；>0 = 成本上限（配合 token-meter 计费）
   ```
2. **触发语义**：达到上限 → 循环停止 + 明确的失败码（如 `LOOP_CIRCUIT_OPEN`）+ 一句人类可读说明（"已到达步数上限，可能是循环；换一种方式重试或检查工具调用模式"）——**不是静默停**，让用户一眼知道发生了什么。
3. **恢复**：新 turn / 新会话 / 用户确认后重置；熔断状态持久化到会话事件（`turn/end` reason 带 code），可审计。
4. **与 dsh-budget 的关系**：dsh-budget 是外部策略层（超限行为可自定义）；内置熔断是**内核兜底**（即使不装插件，默认防呆也在），两者语义协作不冲突。

**落地位置**：agent-loop 的 turn 边界计数（steps）+ token-meter 的累计计数器（tokens/cost）→ 熔断检查放在每步 dispatch 前。

**回归测试**：① 循环场景（模型连续请求同一工具）→ 步数上限触发 `LOOP_CIRCUIT_OPEN`；② token 上限触发；③ 恢复路径（新 turn 重置）。

如果两位 OP（#3228/#3229）认可，我可以把这个草稿扩成完整的 proposal 帖（含代码位置与测试骨架）。

这个现象更像 Agent step loop 持续收到“成功的搜索结果”后再次决定调用工具，而不只是单次工具并发过高。当前源码里的 `maxParallelToolCalls` 只限制一个 step 内的并发，compaction 也只控制上下文压力；它们都不是整轮调用/费用上限。

建议先按这个顺序止损和取证：

1. 运行中按 Esc 或 Ctrl+C，并同时观察 provider usage 是否停止；
2. 保存连续的 assistant → tool call → tool result 事件和每次请求 usage；
3. 不要原样 resume，同一任务换新 Session，缩小到只读工具和明确完成条件；
4. 在 provider 项目侧设置独立的额度/消费上限。

我把这些边界、四种循环类型和最小 incident bundle 整理成了一个独立英文 runbook（基于 `99f6f02` 源码，不是官方文档）：https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/runaway-agent-loop.html

如果能补充取消前后最后 5–10 个 Session events，会很容易判断是成功工具调用循环、工具失败循环还是 provider retry。

discussions.title: [Bug Report] 剪贴板粘贴图片报「仅支持 PNG、JPG、WebP、GIF 格式的图片」——影响第三方识图插件 dsh-vision-router 的粘贴流程

nodes.body:
核验通过（对照 main/master HEAD `99f6f02` rc.7）——客户端只按浏览器声明 MIME 白名单、不嗅探字节，判断准确。补充两个落点细节：

**1. 代码确认。** `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/service.ts:326-334`：`imageMediaType()` 精确白名单 png/jpeg/webp/gif，其余抛 `UnsupportedImageMediaTypeError`；`:165` 逐文件校验；`InputBar.tsx:440` 的 `intakeImages()` 整批拒绝——Firefox 把 CF_DIB 暴露为 `image/bmp` 时必现。服务端 `attachment-local` 的 sharp 字节嗅探（`IMAGE_TYPE_MISMATCH`）证明**字节嗅探能力已经存在**，缺的只是客户端入口放行。

**2. 修复方向（两个改动，各一行到几行）：**
- **入口宽容 + 字节裁决**：`imageMediaType` 对 `image/bmp`（或任何未知 `image/*`）不再直接抛错，改为"放行进字节嗅探路径"——服务端 sharp 已经做真伪裁决（声明 BMP 实际 PNG → 按真实类型接受或明确拒绝），客户端 MIME 只是浏览器声明，不该是唯一裁决者；
- **FileDrop + 位图重复入栏**（Chrome 下同一截图进两次）：`intakeImages` 应去重（同一文件的 FileDrop 项与 bitmap 项按内容指纹/文件路径合并），否则剪贴板粘贴一次会带两张图。

**3. 建议的回归测试**：构造 `File`（type='image/bmp'，内容为合法 PNG 字节）走 intake → 断言进入附件栏而非报错；以及重复 FileDrop 去重断言。

插件侧无解（图片在附件创建前被拦）的判断正确——这是官方 composer 入口问题，值得单独修。

nodes.body:
I turned this reproduction into a source-backed operator runbook: https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/workspace-moved-spawn-enoent.html

The key diagnostic distinction is useful: `spawn bash ENOENT` does not prove that Bash is missing. At rc.7, the Bash tool derives its default workdir from `session.header.cwd`, and the local executor passes that value as the child-process `cwd`; the upstream executor test also confirms that a nonexistent workdir rejects with `ENOENT`.

One safety refinement to the immediate workaround: recreating the old path as an empty directory is a good `pwd`-only diagnostic, but it should not be treated as project recovery. A succeeding Agent command could then run without the expected repository files, instructions, lockfiles, or policy context. For continued work, move the complete project back, use a carefully validated compatibility symlink, or start a fresh Session at the new canonical path.

The guide links each claim to the pinned rc.7 source and includes a minimal incident evidence template. Thanks for the precise reproduction.

discussions.title: [CLI] headless / TUI can't use agent presets (persona) — mount() is coupled to the web frontend
`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` should not be the global AGENTS.md

nodes.body:
Source-verified on rc.7 (`99f6f02`): this collision is real, and it affects more than naming.

The current loader has two independent rules:

1. `USER_GLOBAL_FILE` is fixed to `AGENTS.md`, resolved under the plugin's `dshHome` (normally `$DSH_HOME` / `~/.dsh`).
2. Project discovery defaults to `AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md` plus the local overlays. If no configured root marker is found while walking upward, `findProjectRoot()` falls back to the Session cwd.

So when the Session cwd is `$DSH_HOME`, the same physical path can carry both meanings: fixed user-global instructions and the workspace-root `AGENTS.md` candidate. The renderer's dedup is per displayed directory, not a global same-absolute-path dedup, so operators should not assume the duplicate meaning is automatically collapsed.

A separate fixed global path, as proposed here, would restore a useful invariant:

- `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`: project instructions when working on the DSH configuration directory
- a distinct path such as `$DSH_HOME/agent/AGENTS.md`: user-global instructions

A migration would need to define backward compatibility, because moving the default silently would make existing global policy disappear. The baseline identity already includes discovery and precedence configuration, so a changed path/config can correctly append a superseding baseline rather than rewriting history.

Until that ships, the safe operator rule is to treat `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` as global only. Use a direct task instruction, an explicit Skill, or a separate version-controlled configuration workspace for DSH-home-specific guidance. Do not use symlink tricks: final-component instruction symlinks are intentionally followed and can cross the repository trust boundary.

I mapped the verified baseline order, local overlays, nested structured-fs discovery, refresh behavior, budget eviction, and this collision here:
https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/deepseek-harness-agents-md.html

Disclosure: independent community guide, verified against rc.7; it does not imply the proposed path split is already released.

discussions.title: Code Mode 下 skill 调用成功，但技能正文不进入下一轮模型上下文（UI 有、模型无）

nodes.body: I traced this against rc.7 (`99f6f02`). The behavior comes from three distinct observers: the Code Mode program receives the canonical Skill value, the trajectory/UI persists the nested dispatch, but `deriveMessages()` only exposes the outer `run_code` result plus `additionalContexts` to the next model step. The Skill tool currently returns/renders its value without deferring an identified instruction context. That is why a fire-and-forget `await tools.skill(...)` can appear successful while the next model sees only `(run_code completed with no output)`. An rc.7-safe workaround is to explicitly return or log `loaded.content`; a durable fix should forward Skill content as a Skill-specific identified instruction context through the existing nested `additionalContexts` path, without exposing ordinary nested tool results. I wrote up the source map, nearby-case distinctions, and regression gates here: https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/code-mode-skill-context.html

discussions.title: Proposal: Make 'lessons learned' a harness-level mechanism (failure → auto-inject → behavior gate)
[Feature Request] Let stdio MCP servers know the calling session's agent/team identity

nodes.body:
Per-call transport metadata is the right direction, but it needs two boundaries that are easy to miss: protocol-version compatibility and the distinction between **routing context** and an **authorization principal**.

### Protocol shape

The MCP [2025-06-18 `CallToolRequest`](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-06-18/schema#calltoolrequest) schema has only `name` and `arguments` in `params`. The [2025-11-25 schema](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/schema#calltoolrequestparams) adds inherited request `_meta` to `CallToolRequestParams`. Since rc.7 uses the earlier protocol, adding `_meta` unconditionally would be a vendor extension, not something every server can assume.

A compatible rollout could be:

1. The server declares support during `initialize`, for example under an experimental `io.deepseek/session-context` capability.
2. The client injects a namespaced object on every `tools/call` only when both sides negotiated it.
3. On a future MCP version whose request schema includes `_meta`, carry it there; on 2025-06-18 use an explicitly versioned DSH extension envelope rather than polluting `arguments`.
4. Never expose these fields in the tool input schema or model-visible arguments.

Example logical payload (field placement depends on the negotiated protocol):

```json
{
  "io.deepseek/session-context": {
    "sessionId": "ses_...",
    "agentId": "agent_...",
    "teamId": "team_...",
    "taskId": "task_...",
    "toolCallId": "call_...",
    "attempt": 1
  }
}
```

### Trust boundary

The stdio child may use the context to select a namespace, but it should not treat an arbitrary `agentId` forwarded from prompt text or a model gateway as proof of authorization. DSH should create the context after its own session/agent resolution and attest it through the already-trusted child transport. If the external memory service is remote, the MCP bridge should exchange that context for a service credential or signed, short-lived capability; it should not forward raw team IDs as bearer authority.

Keep process-scoped data (server URL, bootstrap credential, static configuration) in the child environment. Keep request-scoped data (session, resolved agent/team/task, call attempt, cancellation) in the per-call envelope. A shared stdio child is then safe under concurrent sessions; respawning per session is unnecessary.

### Reference implementation and migration path

[SandBase Harness](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness) currently makes the session handle explicit in its MCP tools: `run_session`, `get_session`, `list_artifacts`, and `stop_session` all require a server-issued `session_id` ([source](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness/blob/c05595f000f1e1905483833aaff14937e3f95ec2/src/mcp/server.ts#L95-L119)). Its stdio bridge credential is configured separately ([source](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness/blob/c05595f000f1e1905483833aaff14937e3f95ec2/src/mcp/server.ts#L66-L76)).

That explicit design is auditable, but it has the same model-omission weakness described here. A safe migration would make the host-attested session context available to the handler while retaining explicit `session_id` for tools that intentionally operate on a different session. If both are present and disagree, reject the call rather than silently choosing one.

I would add concurrency tests for two sessions interleaving calls through one child, retry tests that keep `toolCallId` stable but increment `attempt`, and negative tests proving model-supplied arguments cannot override the host context. Also keep the injected context out of user-visible transcripts unless the audit UI intentionally renders a redacted form.

Affiliation disclosure: I contribute to SandBase Harness. I am linking it as an Apache-2.0 implementation reference, not as an official DeepSeek protocol decision.

discussions.title: Harness Intelligence: Compiling Repeated Reasoning into Runtime Reflexes

nodes.body:
A useful boundary here may be to treat “learning” as an artifact promotion pipeline, rather than allowing the live runtime to rewrite itself:

```text
trajectory set
  -> candidate Skill + verifier
  -> offline replay on the source cases
  -> holdout / counterexample replay
  -> shadow mode
  -> scoped promotion
  -> rollback on verifier or policy regression
```

The important distinction is between three artifact classes:

1. **Skill:** still asks a model to reason, but supplies a reusable procedure, budget, stop condition, and output contract.
2. **Verifier/policy:** deterministic code checks observable properties of the result or action before it is accepted.
3. **Reflex:** deterministic runtime behavior for a narrow condition, such as retry classification, cancellation, caching, or mandatory preflight checks.

I would avoid promoting a Skill directly to a reflex. A safer path is Skill → measurable output contract → verifier → shadowed policy → reflex. The model-generated explanation is not the training signal; the durable signal is the tuple of inputs, observable actions, verifier results, user correction, and environment version.

Some promotion gates that seem important:

- immutable provenance: source trajectories, candidate version, generator model, and evaluator version;
- scope keys: repository/workspace, tool schema, provider/model family, OS, and runtime version;
- negative examples and counterfactual replay, not only successful trajectories;
- permission monotonicity: a learned artifact cannot grant more authority than its parent policy;
- explicit abstention and a fallback to deliberation when its preconditions do not match;
- promotion thresholds based on held-out outcomes, not frequency alone;
- reversible rollout with a small blast radius.

A small working example of the first two layers is SandBase's [multi-source-search Skill](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-skills/tree/main/research/multi-source-search): the Skill defines a finite search budget, independent-source rules, and an evidence-ledger contract; a standard-library offline validator rejects duplicate/unknown evidence, unsupported confidence, and hidden conflicts. It deliberately does **not** claim the evidence is true. That separation—procedural guidance versus deterministic structural verification—has been useful.

For the harness layer, [SandBase Harness](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness) keeps sessions, tool events, audit/replay, permission policies, and sandbox execution in one runtime boundary. The part I would add next for this idea is a first-class `CandidateBehavior` record containing provenance, scope, evaluator suite, rollout state, and rollback target.

I am affiliated with SandBase AI; sharing these links as concrete implementations of the Skill/verifier and runtime/audit layers, not as evidence that this design is settled. The most interesting open question to me is how to construct counterexamples automatically without letting the same model both propose and certify the behavior.

discussions.title: subagent 继承 stale 的 agent.options.provider，忽略 Web 模型选择，导致子代理用错 provider 计费

nodes.body:
你的根因分析很完整，补充三块让机制闭环 + 修复设计评估：

**1. 家族交叉验证 —— 这是同一根因的第 2 个独立报告**

这个"子代理继承冻结的 `parent.options` 而非当前生效路由"的问题，我之前在 #2904 分析过同一机制（`resolveChildAgentOptions` 读 `parent.options.provider` 是创建时冻结值）。你的报告独立复现并给出了更硬的证据（descriptor + request/header 双时间线对照），两帖互为交叉验证——特别是"计费错误账号"这个实际后果，把问题从"路由不一致"升级为"真金白银的账算错"。

**2. 第三层缺口：子代理的 ctx 根本没有 ModelSelectionRef 槽（比"没对齐"更彻底）**

rc.8 里 `installSelection`（api-proxy.ts:1129）只挂在 `composeAgent`（:1180/:1189）——即 **Web 会话装配路径**；而子代理 in-process 创建走 `continuation.ts:458` `this.materialize(...)` → `ctx.agents.create()`，**从不安装 selection 槽**。所以：

- 父代理切模型 = 写 `selectionFor(parent).current`（api-proxy.ts:2230），这个槽是 api-proxy 的 `WeakMap`（:1062），子代理包根本够不到
- 子代理 ctx 上没有任何 `agent/request` 瀑布监听 → `buildRequest`（agent.ts:440）`const route = { provider: this.options.provider ?? '', ... }` 永远从冻结的 options 构造
- 连 `selectionFor` getter 的 requestHeader 回退路径（:1108）在子代理上都不存在

所以修复不能只在"继承值"上打补丁——子代理从路由构造到请求发出，整条链都没有 live 来源。

**3. 修复设计评估：`requestHeader()` vs `ModelSelectionRef.current`**

- `parent.session.requestHeader()`（我在 #2904 提过的前例，`childSessionMeta` 已读 `parent.session.header`）是**近似值**：header 只记录"已发出的请求"，如果用户在 Models 页切换后、父代理下一轮请求之前就派发子代理，requestHeader 还是旧值——你验收条件里"切走 provider 后立即派发"恰恰是 pending 态。
- `selectionFor(parent).current` 才是**精确值**（含 pending 切换）。但它活在 api-proxy 的 WeakMap 里，子代理包无法访问——需要把 live 选择作为注入的 live-default 穿过 `ctx.agents.create()`（或在新 seam 上共享同一个 `WebModelSelectionRef`）。这正是"路由构造（agent.ts:440）"与"descriptor 继承（child-agent.ts:73）"两处都要吃到的同一来源。
- 附带一个点：`resolveChildAgentOptions` 与 `buildRequest` 都读 options，若只改前者（descriptor 好看）而后者仍从 options 构造，第一轮请求照样落到 stale provider——**两处必须同源**。

修复形态建议（按优先级）：① 子代理创建时注入父代理的 live `WebModelSelectionRef`（精确、含 pending）；② 做不到共享 ref 时，退化用 `parent.session.requestHeader()` + 在子代理 ctx 安装 `installModelSelection`（让 child 也有一条可覆盖的瀑布）；③ 最小改动：`resolveChildAgentOptions` 的 provider/model 优先取 live 选择。验收时除了看 `subagent/descriptor.agentProvider`，记得验证子代理首轮 `request/header`（两处同源的硬证据）。

discussions.title: 按场景注入 vs 隔离在存储层：两种记忆注入范式的本质差异

nodes.body:
我最近在给 DSH 做记忆优化插件（`dsh-memory`，见本站另一篇帖 #3671），对这个话题有源码级的实践，补充一些经过验证的观察——**"按场景注入 vs 隔离在存储层"不是选择题，而是由 DSH v0.1-rc.7 的扩展点现状决定的**。

### 先看 DSH 当前能用的注入接缝（源码实证）

我逐一验证过三条路径：

| 路径 | 现状（v0.1-rc.7，代码实证） |
|---|---|
| `agent/pre-step` messages | 会被 `session.append("user/message", {surfaceOp:"append"})` 写进**持久化日志**——注入内容变成会话历史，每步重发，Token 反而膨胀 |
| `llm/stream` 改 `options.messages` | 请求在 `buildRequest` 被 `deepFreeze`，且 waterfall 默认闭包 `() => adapterStream(options, prepared)` 锁死原对象——替换/变更无效，且无任何插件监听过该事件 |
| `system-prompt` section | 可行，但**非持久化内容只能进 system prompt**（请求最前）；一旦内容变化，KV 前缀缓存从第一个被改的 token 起全部失效 |

### 关键结论：稳定性才是注入安全性的前提

所以"隔离在存储层（core 记忆）"在 v0.1 下**不只是更优，而是唯一 KV 安全的选择**——因为 core 记忆**内容稳定**（只在写入时变化），system-prompt section 的前缀字节保持不变，KV 缓存得以复用。

而"按场景注入（recall）"内容易变、命中率波动，在现有接缝下要么变成持久化历史（pre-step）、要么被 deepFreeze 拦死（llm/stream）、要么打断 KV 缓存（section 注入易变内容）——三条路都堵死。

### 我们因此采用的分层（Letta 式）

- **core（隔离在存储层）**：workspace 级持久事实，经**稳定** section 注入，KV 安全，跨会话；
- **recall（按需）**：**模型主动调用** `memory_search` 工具对旧内容做混合（词法+语义）召回，输出严格有界——不是自动注入，而是模型在需要细节时主动取。

实现见 https://github.com/QIANLING-0831/dsh-memory （`dsh-memory-core` / `dsh-memory-tool`，已真机验证）。

### 给官方的一点建议

如果 DSH 后续想支持"按场景自动注入"，最干净的方向是提供一个 **"非持久化 + 请求尾部追加"的接缝**——请求尾部追加不破坏前缀，非持久化不污染日志。有了这个接缝，recall 注入才能真正落地而不用担心 KV 和 Token 成本。

这个帖子很好，正好把两种范式的边界问清楚了。想听大家对自己的记忆框架选型的看法。

nodes.body:
`isModelInvocable` 直接读 `skill.invocation.modelInvocable`，缺 `invocation` 的 SKILL.md 会把进程内 collect 缓存写脏。之后同一条会话每一轮都在 pre-step 挂掉，看起来像对话坏了，其实模型请求根本没发出去。

立刻能做的：

1. 重启 `dsh web`（只清缓存；watcher 若再次扫到那份 SKILL.md 还会再毒一次）。
2. 把没有 `invocation` 的 SKILL.md 移出 `~/.agents/skills`（以及插件往这个目录写的副本），再重启。
3. 不要在已经连续 `UNKNOWN` 的会话里死磕，新开一条验证。

缺字段的 skill 被规范化成 `{modelInvocable:true, userInvocable:true}` 才是正修；在那之前先把坏文件挪走。

nodes.body:
There is now an installable ecosystem path for this without maintaining a
local OAuth forwarding bridge. `pi2dsh` runs the unmodified
`pi-mcp-adapter` package as a DSH plugin: the package continues to own MCP
transport, OAuth, cache, and refresh behavior, while pi2dsh maps its public
Host ABI onto DSH commands, user questions, tools, and the native model loop.

Installation still uses only the official DSH plugin workflow:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-mcp-adapter
```

After declaring the remote server in the standard `.mcp.json` format (for
Atlassian, `https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2` with `auth: "oauth"`),
restart the profile and run this in either dsh-TUI or Web:

```text
/mcp-auth atlassian
```

The acceptance run used the real Atlassian service, not a mock: authorization
server discovery, Dynamic Client Registration, PKCE, the browser localhost
callback, secure credential persistence, MCP reconnect, and discovery of 26
tools all completed. DeepSeek then called the read-only
`atlassian_atlassianUserInfo` tool from both DSH Web and dsh-TUI; the durable
DSH session log contains a non-error `tool/result`. On a local machine the
callback completes automatically and withdraws the fallback paste prompt;
manual URL paste is only needed for SSH/cross-machine browsers that cannot
reach the callback listener. `/pi-mcp logout atlassian` removes the stored
credential.

This is an immediately usable ecosystem compatibility route; it does not claim
that the official `dsh-mcp-client` implementation has been changed. A future
first-party OAuth path can replace it cleanly.

每次切换主模型的时候，子agent模型会跟随主模型一起变更（同主模型），怎么才能固定子agent模型？

nodes.body:
`settings.yaml` 里的 `agent-default-model` 只决定**父会话**的默认模型。内置 `tool-subagent` 没有对称的“子 agent 模型”配置项——子会话吃的是父会话当时的 `parent.options`，所以你在模型选择器里换主模型，新拉起来的子 agent 会跟着走。这是继承，不是单独槽位。

目前能用的做法：

- 需要固定便宜模型打杂：不要在这个会话里切主模型；另开一个会话专门跑强模型、少用 subagent。
- 需要同一会话里主模型可切、子模型钉死：得靠自定义 preset / 插件去覆盖 `tool-subagent` 的 agentOptions（或走会显式传 model 的委托插件）。在 YAML 里再加一行不会生效。
- 已经在跑的子 agent 不会跟着热更新；要验证继承关系，开**新会话**再 spawn。

没有官方的“优先做子 agent 的模型列表”，可以把这个当成功能请求。

There is an immediately usable alternative path for this through `pi2dsh` + the unmodified `pi-mcp-adapter` package. The adapter has its own per-server/per-tool approval policy (`approveTools: true` or a tool-pattern list) and applies the same gate to proxy calls, dynamically registered direct tools, resources, and MCP App-originated calls.

Through pi2dsh, the approval request crosses DSH `userQuestions`; the real-host E2E verifies that a human decision is collected and reused for the session. Headless mode fails closed when approval is required and no answerer exists.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh

```

This is package-owned approval rather than a claim that the official `dsh-mcp-client` now calls `ctx.approval`. The native client still needs the architectural decision discussed here, but users with paid or side-effectful MCP tools can enforce a gate today.

可以直接让 dsh 自己干就行，"帮我把本地 skill 导入进来"，它会自己找目录、建文件、写 frontmatter。

```yaml
---
name: my-helper        # 必须 kebab-case

正文……
```

discussions.title: [Bug] mcp-client: activeServerNames 生命周期泄漏导致无法创建新会话

nodes.body:
我们针对这个问题做了独立的深度分析，已发布为单独的分析帖（含源码级根因修正、设计层审视与方案评估）：

**分析帖：[Analysis] mcp-client activeServerNames: root cause is a scope mismatch, not a missed cleanup — and the proposed "defensive cleanup" is unsafe**  
🔗 <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4025>

三个补充结论（详见分析帖）：

1. **根因修正**：「清理从未被调用」与复现数据存在矛盾——「等待约 30 秒再创建能成功」说明清理**最终执行了，只是延迟**。缺陷在上游（会话关闭 → preset 插件实例 fiber 的销毁链），不在 mcp-client 内部；`dispose()` 本身是完整异步链（`:678-696`），cleanup 是同步的（`:775`）。
2. **设计层问题（原报告未提及）**：`activeServerNames` 以 `ctx.root`（进程级）为 key（`:731`/`:768`），而工具注册表是 **per-agent 作用域**（`dsh-tools` 基于 `ScopedLayers`）——作用域不匹配。即使清理即时且完美，**两个并行会话**挂同一个 `serverName` 也会被唯一性检查拒绝。
3. **方案评估**：方案 1「先删后查」不建议采纳——并行场景下第二个实例会先删除第一个实例的注册再通过检查，导致同一 `serverName` **静默双活**，把确定性报错变成静默故障。方案 2 方向正确，但需先定位上游销毁链的延迟点（约 30 秒）。

验证环境：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2`（源码与 master 快照一致）。

---

## EN (short version)

We published a separate follow-up analysis on this issue (root-cause correction, design-level scope mismatch, and a caution on the proposed fix):

**[Analysis] mcp-client activeServerNames: root cause is a scope mismatch, not a missed cleanup — and the proposed "defensive cleanup" is unsafe**  
🔗 <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4025>

Key points:

1. "Cleanup never runs" contradicts the repro data — "waiting ~30s works" means cleanup *eventually* runs; the defect is upstream (session close → preset fiber teardown chain), not inside mcp-client.
2. Design-level: `activeServerNames` is keyed on `ctx.root` (process-level) while the tool registry is per-agent scoped — even perfect teardown would reject two *parallel* sessions sharing a serverName.
3. Caution on the proposed Fix 1 (defensive delete-then-check): in the concurrent case it lets the second instance pass and silently allows dual-live connections on one serverName.

Verified on `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2`.

nodes.body:
这条需求现在有一条可直接安装的生态路径：`pi2dsh` 运行原版 `pi-mcp-adapter`，MCP transport/OAuth/refresh 仍由能力包自己负责，中间层只投影 DSH 的命令、问题框和工具调用。

Subagents inherit the parent's creation-time model seed instead of its live route, delegation silently runs on for exmaple `openrouter/auto` after the default model is switched

nodes.body:
We hit this on `0.1.1-rc.2` as well (Web GUI `dsh web`, `llm-pi-ai` adapter, Windows), using two providers that share the same logical model under different ids. Independent confirmation of the report:

- The parent session ran **100%** of its requests on provider `bitdeer` (`deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`), and the parent log contains **zero** references to the stale provider.
- **All 43 subagents** spawned by 6 `workflow` runs (in-process `spawn`, one-shot mode) ran on the stale route `opencode-go` / `deepseek-v4-flash`, and at least one child exhausted that provider's **weekly quota** (`429 GoUsageLimitError`, "Weekly usage limit reached") — so the drift is consequential, not cosmetic.

Representative child `request/header` while the parent's own concurrent requests were bitdeer:

```json
{"type":"request/header","data":{"header":{"config":{"provider":"opencode-go","model":"deepseek-v4-flash","maxTokens":384000}}}}
```

Two small observations that may matter for the fix:

1. Our one-shot `spawn` descriptor (`{"version":2,"mode":"one-shot","provider":"spawn"}`) does **not** carry `agentProvider`/`agentModel` like the continuable descriptor in the report — yet the misroute is identical. So the load-bearing fix is `resolveChildAgentOptions` reading the live route; the descriptor only needs mirroring where it stores the pair. And remember the function exists in **two** copies (`dsh-subagent/lib/index.js` bundled + `lib/types/child-agent.js`) — both must change.
2. Contributing hazard in our setup: provider `A` serves the *namespaced* id `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash` while another route (`opencode-go`) owns the *bare* id `deepseek-v4-flash`. We suspect the creation-time seed carried the bare id (the id shared by the base default and that route), which is what made the stale seed land on a specific unintended provider. A warning whenever a request is routed on a bare model id across providers — as suggested in the report — would have surfaced this immediately.

The proposed direction (delegation follows the parent's live route — the folded `requestHeader` — with fallback to the seed only before the first request) matches exactly what we'd expect. We also confirmed the workaround end-to-end: **opening a fresh session after switching the default re-stamps the seed**, so parent and children agree again (with the report's caveat that merely resuming an existing session does not reset its request route — only what future children inherit).

Happy to share sanitized session excerpts or help test the patch against the pi-ai multi-provider adapter.

discussions.title: Bug: LSP server stdout has no error listener — one transport failure crashes the whole host process

nodes.body:
Verified against v0.1.1-rc.2 source — the asymmetry is exact, and your one-line fix is the right minimal change. I traced the surrounding lifecycle to confirm nothing else needs to move with it.

**Source confirmation (packages/lsp/lsp-stdio/src/connection.ts)**
- The stdin error handler at line 130 carries the documenting comment: a child that closes fd 0 while staying alive must fail the connection so pending requests reject immediately instead of waiting for a process-close event that may never arrive. The stdout stream at line 131 gets only a data handler. The same intent applies to a read-side failure (server closes its stdout fd while staying alive, or a kill-escalation race): the fatal-cause path (fail, then failAll, then pool eviction) exists and is designed for exactly this, but is unreachable from a raw stream error event with no listener.
- app-boot registers only unhandledRejection (lines 646-647), not uncaughtException — so a stream error on stdout is not a contained unhandled-rejection but a hard process exit. Your exposure chain holds.
- The subprocess seam hands back the raw child stdout for pipe mode (subprocess-local spawn, stdout exposed when outMode is pipe) — nothing downstream attaches a read-side error handler for the LSP pipe.

**One-line fix**: mirror the stdin line — attach the same error-to-fail handler on stdout next to the data handler. Same semantics as the documented stdin handler; the fail path is idempotent against the later close path (the closeReason latch at lines 113-116 means a second fail after close is a no-op, so no double-eviction concern).

**Regression test shape**: attach a fake subprocess handle whose stdout is a PassThrough; emit an error on it; assert the connection failed flag flips and pending requests reject with that error before any close event. Also assert a subsequent close does not double-evict.

**Family**: this is the second member of the connection-lifecycle family I documented with #4059 (the upgrade-socket error listener removed inside the close callback, packages/host/webserver/src/index.ts:202-204 — a late ECONNRESET with zero listeners terminates the whole dsh web process). Same root shape: a stream or socket whose error path is unlistened, converting a contained transport failure into a whole-process crash. The #4059 fix there is also about two lines (keep the listener plus a destroyed guard); together they suggest a sweep — any other stdout/stderr pipe consumers that attach only a data handler without a sibling error handler are candidates for the same crash class.

Nice catch on the stdin/stdout asymmetry — the existing comment at lines 127-129 states the design intent, so the fix is strictly finishing the intended behavior.

discussions.title: BUG: Spawned subagents inherit `agent.options` stamped at agent creation, not the agent's current model selection

nodes.body:
Verified against v0.1.1-rc.2 source — your diagnosis is correct, and the 43-subagent/429-quota observation makes it the strongest evidence yet for a mechanism that has now been independently reported three times. This is the fifth member of a family I have been tracking; the fix blueprint already exists.

**Source confirmation**
- `resolveChildAgentOptions` (`packages/subagent/subagent/src/child-agent.ts:68-83`) copies `parent.options.provider/model/maxTokens` and spreads the per-call override. It reads the *creation-time snapshot*, exactly as you describe.
- `installModelSelection` (`packages/core/agent/src/model-selection.ts:39-78`) registers `system-prompt/assemble` and `agent/request` waterfall handlers on the **parent's scoped ctx**. The child is composed on its own ctx via `ctx.agents.create(...)` (continuation.ts) — it never enters the parent's selections map, so no handler rewrites its route. Your "separate layer only overrides the current agent's own requests" is precisely right.
- Seed timing locks it: `buildRequest` (`agent-loop/src/agent.ts:440-486`) seeds the first `request/header` from `this.options` when `!requestHeaderLogged` — the divergence is decided entirely at seed time.

**Family (5 reports, same root: creation-time snapshot vs live selection)**
- #2904 — subagent auth-401: frozen `parent.options` after a mid-session switch, 100% child dispatch failure with dead credentials.
- #3552 — subagent billing-misroute: same frozen-options mechanism, independent repro, wrong billing account. Root-cause analysis matched yours; I identified the third-layer gap there: the child ctx has no selection slot installed at all (no `agent/request` waterfall, so `buildRequest` always reads frozen options).
- #4077 (this report) — same mechanism, now with the quota-exhaustion consequence (429 GoUsageLimitError). Your parent-log-contains-zero-references-to-opencode-go point is the cleanest discriminator for this class.
- #3565 — compaction summarization: `summarizer.ts` prefers `session.requestHeader()?.config` over the configured target, which can be days stale on resumed sessions → zero cache reuse + wrong-provider billing. Same "last routed header as default" heuristic, same freshness problem.
- #1627/#1703/#2143 — replay-state coherence (truncate/continue mid-tool-call): persisted context vs live metadata diverge, hard-fail the turn.
Common lesson: any "inherit from the parent/persisted artifact" default is sound only while the source is warm; once it can outlive a model switch or a session resume it needs a freshness guard. Fix shape shared across all members: inject the live source over the persisted snapshot.

**Fix blueprint (three tiers, from the earlier analysis)**
1. **Minimal (one call site)**: in `resolveChildAgentOptions`, prefer `parent.session.requestHeader()?.config` over `parent.options` — `requestHeader()` is a public Session API (`session/index.ts:670`) and the module doc notes both the one-shot driver and the continuation manager compose children through this one function, so one change covers `subagent` and `subagent_fork`. There is even a precedent in the same file: `childSessionMeta` (child-agent.ts:102) already reads `parent.session.header` for durable metadata.
2. **Edge case**: a child spawned *immediately after* the switch, before the parent's next request, still sees a stale folded header (the picker's pending selection is not yet in any request/header). Fixing that needs the child to share the parent's live `WebModelSelectionRef` (crosses the api-proxy/subagent boundary), or moving the route decision to the child's first `agent/request` waterfall.
3. **Symmetric long-term**: in-process children share the parent's selection ref so `/model` picker switches propagate too — and keep the two sources aligned (`child-agent.ts:73` inheritance and `agent.ts:440` route construction), otherwise only the descriptor/header first request gets fixed and later steps drift again.

**Blind spot worth checking**: continuable children on cold resume — does the resume path re-resolve the route from the live default, or keep the stale persisted header until the first request? If the latter, the resume path needs the same freshness guard (this is exactly what bit #3565).

One question for your repro: were the workflow subagents spawned through the in-process provider (continuable) or the fork provider? The fork path re-creates the agent from the live default on resume, which would mask the bug in some scenarios — your 43/43 consistency suggests in-process, but confirming pins the fix surface.
